UI_TITLE_SUB.en: Sherefox: The Fox Detective of the Fog City

WARN_QUIT.zh-TW: 要離開遊戲嗎？未存檔的進度將會遺失。
WARN_QUIT.en: Quit the game? Unsaved progress will be lost.

WARN_NEWGAME_OVER.zh-TW: 開始新遊戲不會刪除現有的存檔。要開始嗎？
WARN_NEWGAME_OVER.en: Starting a new game will not delete your existing saves. Start anyway?

UI_DIFF_STORY_DESC.zh-TW: 想專心看故事的人。論戰寬鬆，提示完整，可以隨時重來。
UI_DIFF_STORY_DESC.en: For those who just want the story. Debates are lenient, hints are complete, and you can retry any time.

UI_DIFF_NORMAL_DESC.zh-TW: 本作設計的體驗。要取捨、要推理，也允許失敗。
UI_DIFF_NORMAL_DESC.en: The experience the game was designed around. Weigh your choices, reason it out, and failure is allowed.

UI_DIFF_MASTER_DESC.zh-TW: 沒有預估、沒有重來。蒐證更緊，對手更狠。
UI_DIFF_MASTER_DESC.en: No estimates, no retries. Tighter searches, nastier opponents.

UI_DIFF_NOTE.zh-TW: 難度可在每章開始時於設定中更改。True End 在所有難度皆可達成。
UI_DIFF_NOTE.en: You can change the difficulty in Settings at the start of each chapter. The True End is achievable on every difficulty.

WARN_TO_TITLE.zh-TW: 要回到標題畫面嗎？未存檔的進度將會遺失。
WARN_TO_TITLE.en: Return to the title screen? Unsaved progress will be lost.

MSG_FAST_UNREAD.zh-TW: 以下為未讀內容，已停止快轉。

UI_TYPE_CRIMINAL_DESC.zh-TW: 他在說謊，主張裡一定藏著與事實衝突的矛盾。攻擊居多，被逼急就猛攻：等他開口時用反駁截斷最有效。
UI_TYPE_CRIMINAL_DESC.en: He is lying, so his claims must hide a contradiction with the facts. Mostly attacks, and goes on the Onslaught when pushed: Rebut him as he speaks up for the best effect.

UI_TYPE_PROTECTOR_DESC.zh-TW: 他想保護某個人，會轉移焦點、打感情牌。補強居多：觀察與醜聞類證物最有效，補強時用詭辯可以打穿。
UI_TYPE_PROTECTOR_DESC.en: He is shielding someone, deflecting and playing on emotion. Mostly Reinforces: Observe and Scandal evidence work best, and Sophistry punches through a Reinforce.

UI_TYPE_RIVAL_DESC.zh-TW: 他有自己的證物，包括你漏掉的那些。他會預判你重複上一手並出剋招，預兆可能是偽裝。換招，並且小心你的弱點。
UI_TYPE_RIVAL_DESC.en: He has evidence of his own, including what you missed. He predicts you will repeat your last move and counters it, and his Tells may be Disguised. Change things up, and mind your Weak Points.

UI_TYPE_NEMESIS_DESC.zh-TW: 她的推理完全自洽，預兆常是偽裝：台詞會騙人，小動作不會。只有鏈外的事實能打破它。
UI_TYPE_NEMESIS_DESC.en: Her reasoning is perfectly self-consistent and her Tells are often Disguised: her words lie, her gestures do not. Only a fact from outside the chain can break it.

UI_TYPE_MIXED_DESC.zh-TW: 隨著局勢改變打法。注意狀態列上目前的類型。
UI_TYPE_MIXED_DESC.en: Changes tactics as the situation shifts. Watch the type shown in the status bar.

MSG_TALK_LIMIT.en: {name} doesn't want to talk any more.

MSG_DEVICE_NEED.zh-TW: 需要某樣東西才能打開。
MSG_DEVICE_NEED.en: You need something to open this.

MSG_PERMIT_TRUST.zh-TW: 巴斯克維爾警督：「這裡讓你進去。別亂碰。」
MSG_PERMIT_TRUST.en: Inspector Baskerville: "I'll let you in here. Don't touch anything."

UI_NEGO_PROMPT.zh-TW: 出示一件證物說服 {name}。（剩餘機會 {left}）
UI_NEGO_PROMPT.en: Present a piece of evidence to persuade {name}. (Chances left: {left})

MSG_NEGO_LOCK.zh-TW: 這條路行不通了。區域改為封鎖。
MSG_NEGO_LOCK.en: That route is closed. The area is now Sealed.

MSG_SNEAK_NOTICK.en: Not enough Ticks to sneak in.

MSG_SNEAK_FORBID.zh-TW: 這裡戒備太森嚴，潛不進去。
MSG_SNEAK_FORBID.en: Security is too tight here to sneak in.

UI_APPR_CONFIRM.zh-TW: {type}鑑定・消耗 {cost} 次・剩餘 {left} 次。要鑑定嗎？

MSG_APPR_DONE.zh-TW: 鑑定完成：新的標籤已揭露。

MSG_APPR_EMPTY.zh-TW: 本案的鑑定次數已經用完。
MSG_APPR_EMPTY.en: No appraisals left for this case.

MSG_APPR_LOCKED.en: You can't appraise during a debate.

MSG_INV_NEED.zh-TW: 還有一定得找到的東西。再找找看。
MSG_INV_NEED.en: There is still something you must find. Keep looking.

WARN_INV_END.zh-TW: 還剩 {left} 格刻度。結束後就不能回到現場了，要結束蒐證嗎？
WARN_INV_END.en: {left} Ticks remain. You can't return to the scene once the search ends. End the search?

WARN_INV_END_ZERO.zh-TW: 所有地方都看過了。要結束蒐證嗎？
WARN_INV_END_ZERO.en: You've looked everywhere. End the search?

MSG_INV_SEAL.en: {name} has sealed off part of the scene. (Ticks −{n})

MSG_INV_RESCUE.en: Arthur picked this up for you: {name}

MSG_INV_MISSED.zh-TW: 有 {n} 件證物落入對手手中。
MSG_INV_MISSED.en: {n} pieces of evidence have fallen into the opponent's hands.

MSG_INV_MISSED_NONE.zh-TW: 現場的證物，一件都沒漏。
MSG_INV_MISSED_NONE.en: You missed nothing at the scene.

UI_EVBOOK_GOLD_EMPTY.zh-TW: 檔案裡還沒有能用的東西。
UI_EVBOOK_GOLD_EMPTY.en: Nothing usable in the files yet.

MSG_CMP_WRONG.en: This is the same as before.

UI_BOARD_REASON.zh-TW: 歸類理由：這件證物證明了……

UI_BOARD_CHAIN.zh-TW: 推理鏈 {n}：{cards} 張・實證 {solid}・詭辯 {soph}・預估傷害 {dmg}
UI_BOARD_CHAIN.en: Chain {n}: {cards} cards · Solid {solid} · Sophistry {soph} · Est. damage {dmg}

UI_BOARD_WEAK.zh-TW: 弱點：對手反擊時會優先攻擊這裡。
UI_BOARD_WEAK.en: Weak Point: the opponent's counterattack hits here first.

UI_BOARD_COND_EARLY.zh-TW: 對手動搖時，出示 1 件強攻證物，或 2 張以上的實證連鎖
UI_BOARD_COND_EARLY.en: When the opponent is Shaken: present 1 Striker evidence, or a Solid Chain of 2 or more cards

UI_BOARD_COND_MID.zh-TW: 對手動搖時，出示 2～3 張無弱點連鎖；或命中失言後的主張
UI_BOARD_COND_MID.en: When the opponent is Shaken: present a chain of 2-3 cards with no Weak Points, or hit a claim exposed by a slip

UI_BOARD_COND_LATE.zh-TW: 對手動搖時，出示 3～4 張以上的連鎖，其中要有黃金線索
UI_BOARD_COND_LATE.en: When the opponent is Shaken: present a chain of 3-4 or more cards that includes a Golden Clue

MSG_LINK_INVALID.zh-TW: 這兩件證物沒有共同點。
MSG_LINK_INVALID.en: These two pieces of evidence have nothing in common.

MSG_LINK_NOREASON.zh-TW: 先替這件證物選好理由。
MSG_LINK_NOREASON.en: Choose a Rationale for this evidence first.

MSG_LINK_HIDDEN.zh-TW: 這件證物還有看不出來的地方。
MSG_LINK_HIDDEN.en: This evidence has details you can't make out yet.

MSG_CHAIN_MAX.zh-TW: 一條推理鏈最多 5 張，板上最多 3 條。
MSG_CHAIN_MAX.en: A Reasoning Chain holds at most 5 cards, and the board holds at most 3 chains.

MSG_CHAIN_BRANCH.en: A Reasoning Chain must run in a straight line.

MSG_GOLD_REVEAL.zh-TW: 檔案裡有一份東西，現在派得上用場了：{name}（取得於 {chapter}）
MSG_GOLD_REVEAL.en: Something in the files has become useful: {name} (obtained in {chapter})

MSG_GOLD_ASSIST.en: "{name}" makes one of your inferences clearer.

MSG_BOARD_NOCHAIN.zh-TW: 至少要組出一條推理鏈，才能進入論戰。
MSG_BOARD_NOCHAIN.en: Form at least one Reasoning Chain before entering the Debate.

WARN_BOARD_NOREASON.zh-TW: 有 {n} 張卡還沒選理由，它們不能參戰。仍要進入論戰嗎？
WARN_BOARD_NOREASON.en: {n} cards have no Rationale and can't join the fight. Enter the Debate anyway?

WARN_BOARD_UNAPPR.zh-TW: 還有 {n} 件證物沒鑑定，亞瑟還能鑑定 {left} 次。仍要進入論戰嗎？
WARN_BOARD_UNAPPR.en: {n} pieces of evidence are unappraised, and Arthur can still appraise {left} more. Enter the Debate anyway?

WARN_BOARD_LOCK.zh-TW: 進入論戰後，歸類理由將會鎖定，論戰中也不能修改線索板。確定嗎？
WARN_BOARD_LOCK.en: Once the Debate begins, Rationales are locked and the Clue Board can't be edited. Are you sure?

WARN_BOARD_REMOVE.zh-TW: 移除這張卡會一併刪除它的連結。要移除嗎？
WARN_BOARD_REMOVE.en: Removing this card will also delete its links. Remove it?

UI_DEB_DISGUISER.zh-TW: 此對手的預兆可能是偽裝：台詞與小動作對不上時，以小動作為準。
UI_DEB_DISGUISER.en: This opponent's Tells may be Disguised: when their words and gestures disagree, trust the gesture.

UI_DEB_LOCK_SUMMARY_PARRY.zh-TW: 反駁　對準：{node}　出示：{card}

UI_DEB_LOCK_SUMMARY_OBSERVE.zh-TW: 觀察　這回合不出牌

UI_DEB_PREVIEW_PARRY_NOREF.zh-TW: 截斷：反擊 30（這個說法太堅固，主張會留著）
UI_DEB_PREVIEW_PARRY_NOREF.en: Cut-In: counter 30 (this claim is too sturdy and will stay)

UI_TABLE_SOLID_ATK.zh-TW: 交鋒：雙方都受傷（你的傷害減半）；含破解證物時移除該主張
UI_TABLE_SOLID_ATK.en: Clash: both sides take damage (yours is halved); if the chain contains evidence that refutes the claim, the claim is removed

UI_TABLE_SOLID_REINFORCE.zh-TW: 傷害減半，仍可移除主張
UI_TABLE_SOLID_REINFORCE.en: Damage halved; the claim can still be removed

UI_TABLE_SOLID_TRAP.zh-TW: 陷阱落空，全額傷害；對方下回合不能補強
UI_TABLE_SOLID_TRAP.en: The trap whiffs and you deal full damage; the opponent can't Reinforce next round

UI_TABLE_SOPH_ATK.zh-TW: 交鋒：雙方都受傷（你的傷害減半）
UI_TABLE_SOPH_ATK.en: Clash: both sides take damage (yours is halved)

UI_TABLE_SOPH_TRAP.zh-TW: 中陷阱：傷害作廢，受暴擊、虛線斷開、惡名 +1
UI_TABLE_SOPH_TRAP.en: Caught in the trap: damage void, you take a crit, the dashed link snaps, Notoriety +1

UI_TABLE_PARRY_ATK.zh-TW: 截斷：不受傷、粉碎主張、反擊 30；截斷猛攻時對方動搖
UI_TABLE_PARRY_ATK.en: Cut-In: you take no damage, the claim is smashed, counter 30; cutting in on an Onslaught leaves the opponent Shaken

UI_TABLE_OBS_ATK.zh-TW: 受傷減半；下回合預兆變為明示
UI_TABLE_OBS_ATK.en: Take half damage; next round's Tell becomes Clear

UI_TABLE_OBS_REINFORCE.en: The opponent gains a Fragile claim

UI_TABLE_OBS_TRAP.zh-TW: 拆穿陷阱：對方多一個脆弱主張，下回合必定攻擊
UI_TABLE_OBS_TRAP.en: Trap exposed: the opponent gains a Fragile claim and must attack next round

UI_NOTES_RULE_1.zh-TW: 主張被推翻後，下一手傾向補強。
UI_NOTES_RULE_1.en: After a claim is overturned, tends to Reinforce next.

UI_NOTES_RULE_2.zh-TW: 你上一回合出詭辯，下一手傾向設陷。
UI_NOTES_RULE_2.en: If you used Sophistry last round, tends to Set a Trap next.

UI_NOTES_RULE_3.zh-TW: 主導權第一次降到一半以下時，下一手必定猛攻（明示）。
UI_NOTES_RULE_3.en: The first time Dominance falls to half or below, the next move is always an Onslaught (Clear).

UI_NOTES_RULE_4.zh-TW: 補強成功後，下一手傾向主張。
UI_NOTES_RULE_4.en: After a successful Reinforce, tends to Assert next.

UI_NOTES_RULE_5.zh-TW: 同一招連續出兩次後，第三次一定換招。
UI_NOTES_RULE_5.en: After the same move twice in a row, always switches on the third.

UI_NOTES_RULE_4W.zh-TW: 她補強成功後不急著主張，傾向設陷。
UI_NOTES_RULE_4W.en: After a successful Reinforce she doesn't rush to Assert; she tends to Set a Trap.

UI_NOTES_RULE_MIRROR.zh-TW: 他預判你會重複上一回合的行動，先出它的剋招。
UI_NOTES_RULE_MIRROR.en: He predicts you will repeat your last move, and plays its counter first.

UI_NOTES_LOG_ROW.zh-TW: 第 {n} 回合　預兆：{tell}　你：{mine}　對方：{theirs}　{result}

MSG_DEB_SELECT_ACTION.en: Choose your action for this round.

MSG_DEB_SELECT_CHAIN.en: Choose the chain segment to present.

MSG_DEB_SELECT_TARGET.zh-TW: 選擇要攻擊的主張（預設是亮起的那一個）。
MSG_DEB_SELECT_TARGET.en: Choose the claim to attack (the lit one by default).

MSG_DEB_SELECT_PARRY.zh-TW: 選擇要用來截斷的證物。
MSG_DEB_SELECT_PARRY.en: Choose the evidence to cut in with.

MSG_DEB_NOTAG.zh-TW: 這段推理和那個主張扯不上關係。
MSG_DEB_NOTAG.en: That reasoning has nothing to do with that claim.

MSG_DEB_NOSOLID.zh-TW: 這段推理裡有虛線，只能用「詭辯」出示。
MSG_DEB_NOSOLID.en: This reasoning contains a dashed line, so it can only be presented as Sophistry.

MSG_DEB_NOSOPH.zh-TW: 這段推理沒有虛線。要硬接一條嗎？
MSG_DEB_NOSOPH.en: This reasoning has no dashed line. Improvise one?

MSG_DEB_HIDDEN_TARGET.zh-TW: 對方還沒把這件事說出口。
MSG_DEB_HIDDEN_TARGET.en: They haven't said that out loud yet.

MSG_DEB_NO_TARGET.zh-TW: 現在手上的推理都打不到對方。可以防守，或臨場硬接一條線。
MSG_DEB_NO_TARGET.en: None of your current reasoning can reach them. Defend, or improvise a link on the spot.

MSG_DEB_STURDY.zh-TW: 這個說法太堅固了。用實證連鎖打，或在他開口時用黃金線索截斷。
MSG_DEB_STURDY.en: That claim is too sturdy. Hit it with a Solid Chain, or cut in with a Golden Clue as they speak.

MSG_DEB_STANDOFF.en: Standoff: neither side made a move.

MSG_DEB_PARRY_NOREF.zh-TW: 擋住了，但這個說法太堅固——要用黃金線索才推得翻。
MSG_DEB_PARRY_NOREF.en: Blocked, but that claim is too sturdy: only a Golden Clue can overturn it.

MSG_DEB_PARRY_WHIFF.zh-TW: 對方沒有開口，你的反駁落空了。
MSG_DEB_PARRY_WHIFF.en: They didn't speak up, so your Rebut whiffed.

MSG_DEB_PARRY_OFFSET.zh-TW: 對方推的是另一個說法！

MSG_DEB_TRAP_MISS.zh-TW: 陷阱落空！{name} 下回合不能補強。
MSG_DEB_TRAP_MISS.en: The trap whiffs! {name} can't Reinforce next round.

MSG_DEB_TRAP_EXPOSED.zh-TW: 你看穿了陷阱。{name} 下回合必定出手。
MSG_DEB_TRAP_EXPOSED.en: You saw through the trap. {name} will definitely strike next round.

MSG_DEB_OBSERVE.en: You listen quietly as they go on.

MSG_DEB_OBSERVE_HALF.zh-TW: 你沉住氣，只受了一半的傷。
MSG_DEB_OBSERVE_HALF.en: You stay composed and take only half the damage.

MSG_DEB_SHAKEN_RUSH.zh-TW: 猛攻被截斷，{name} 亂了陣腳！
MSG_DEB_SHAKEN_RUSH.en: The Onslaught was cut off, and {name} loses their footing!

MSG_DEB_BREAK_TURN.en: Now is the time to Break.

MSG_DEB_PARRY_BREAK_MISS.zh-TW: 對方沒有開口——論破的時機錯過了。
MSG_DEB_PARRY_BREAK_MISS.en: They didn't speak up, and the chance to Break has passed.

MSG_DEB_WEAK_HIT.en: Your Weak Point was seen through!

MSG_DEB_LINK_CUT.zh-TW: 那條虛線斷了。下一回合不算倍率。
MSG_DEB_LINK_CUT.en: That dashed line snapped. No multiplier next round.

WARN_DEB_ASSIST.zh-TW: 亞瑟：「這回合我替妳盯著陷阱？援護只有一次。」
WARN_DEB_ASSIST.en: Arthur: "Shall I watch for traps this round? I can only Cover once."

MSG_DEB_ASSISTED.zh-TW: 亞瑟擋下了暴擊。這一回合的攻擊還是落空了。
MSG_DEB_ASSISTED.en: Arthur blocked the crit. Your attack this round still came to nothing.

UI_DEB_ASSIST_ARMED.zh-TW: 援護待命：這回合若被陷阱抓到，亞瑟會擋下暴擊（鎖定即用掉）
UI_DEB_ASSIST_ARMED.en: Cover ready: if a trap catches you this round, Arthur blocks the crit (spent as soon as you lock in)

MSG_DEB_ASSIST_WASTED.zh-TW: 他沒有設陷——援護白白用掉了。
MSG_DEB_ASSIST_WASTED.en: No trap was set, so Cover was wasted.

UI_DEB_NOPARRY_NOCARD.zh-TW: 沒有能推翻這個主張的證物
UI_DEB_NOPARRY_NOCARD.en: No evidence that can overturn this claim

MSG_DEB_NOPARRY_NOCARD.zh-TW: 手上沒有能推翻這個主張的證物——截斷不了他。
MSG_DEB_NOPARRY_NOCARD.en: You have no evidence that can overturn this claim, so you can't cut in on them.

MSG_DEB_INSTINCT_USE.zh-TW: 狐耳一動——{name} 真正想做的是……
MSG_DEB_INSTINCT_USE.en: A fox ear twitches. What {name} really means to do is…

MSG_DEB_INSTINCT_EMPTY.en: Fox-Ear Instinct has been used up.

MSG_DEB_RULE_NEW.zh-TW: 亞瑟在筆記上寫了一行：「{rule}」
MSG_DEB_RULE_NEW.en: Arthur jotted a line in his notes: "{rule}"

MSG_DEB_LASTNODE.en: {name} is clinging to one last claim.

WARN_DEB_REVERSE.zh-TW: 危險：這段推理含 3 條以上詭辯，援護已用完
WARN_DEB_REVERSE.en: Danger: this chain has 3 or more Sophistry links and Cover is spent

WARN_DEB_OBSERVE_TAIL.zh-TW: 現在是尾聲，觀察擋不住對方的反撲（主導權 −{n}）。仍要觀察嗎？
WARN_DEB_OBSERVE_TAIL.en: This is the Endgame. Observe can't stop their counterattack (Dominance −{n}). Observe anyway?

MSG_DEB_IMPATIENT.zh-TW: 聽眾開始不耐煩了。（對手攻擊 +5）
MSG_DEB_IMPATIENT.en: The audience is growing restless. (Opponent attack +5)

UI_DEB_PHASE.zh-TW: 第 {n} 階段／共 {total} 階段

MSG_OPINION_UP.en: The crowd is coming over to your side.

MSG_OPINION_DOWN.en: The crowd is starting to boo you.

WARN_DEB_DELEGATE.zh-TW: 委託亞瑟代辯會直接判定勝利，但這場不計入 True End 的「全部論戰勝利」。要委託嗎？
WARN_DEB_DELEGATE.en: Delegating to Arthur wins the debate outright, but it won't count toward "all debates won" for the True End. Delegate?

WARN_DEB_GIVEUP.zh-TW: 放棄會直接判定敗北。確定嗎？
WARN_DEB_GIVEUP.en: Forfeiting counts as an immediate loss. Are you sure?

MSG_WARMUP_PERFECT.en: You convinced him in one go.

ART_REVIEW_PARRY_WHIFF.zh-TW: 「這一手，他是在護東西，不是要開口。」
ART_REVIEW_PARRY_WHIFF.en: "That round he was protecting something, not about to speak."

ART_REVIEW_TRAP.zh-TW: 「他那時候在等妳的虛線。我記得他的動作。」
ART_REVIEW_TRAP.en: "He was waiting for your dashed line. I remember his gesture."

ART_REVIEW_CLASH.zh-TW: 「他要開口的時候，妳也搶著說話了。」
ART_REVIEW_CLASH.en: "He was about to speak, and you jumped in at the same time."

ART_REVIEW_DISGUISE.zh-TW: 「他嘴上那樣說，手可不是那樣做的。」
ART_REVIEW_DISGUISE.en: "That's what his mouth said. It's not what his hands were doing."

ART_REVIEW_TAIL.zh-TW: 「最後那一下，要的不是那張牌。」
ART_REVIEW_TAIL.en: "For that last move, that wasn't the card you needed."

ART_REVIEW_HEAL.en: "He kept reinforcing while we kept waiting."

UI_BREAK_LINE.zh-TW: 等一下，我已經徹底解開了！

UI_BREAK_LINE_PARRY.zh-TW: 等一下——你剛才說的那句話，就是答案。
UI_BREAK_LINE_PARRY.en: Hold on—what you just said is the answer.

MSG_TAIL_START.zh-TW: {name} 被逼到了絕境——但還沒認輸。
MSG_TAIL_START.en: {name} is driven to the brink, but hasn't given up yet.

MSG_TAIL_PROTECTOR.zh-TW: {name}：「揭穿真相只會毀了一切，你承擔得起嗎？」
MSG_TAIL_PROTECTOR.en: {name}: "Exposing the truth will only ruin everything. Can you bear that?"

MSG_TAIL_WRONG.zh-TW: 對方的反撲打中了你！（主導權 −{n}）

MSG_TAIL_REFLECT.zh-TW: 冷冰冰的證據說不動他。
MSG_TAIL_REFLECT.en: Cold, hard evidence doesn't move them.

MSG_TAIL_TIMEOUT.en: {name} weathered the storm. The Break is void!

MSG_TAIL_THRESHOLD_UP.zh-TW: 這場論戰的論破條件提高了：需要多 1 張證物。
MSG_TAIL_THRESHOLD_UP.en: This debate's Break requirement has gone up: one more piece of evidence is needed.

MSG_REBUILD.zh-TW: 絕境重組——對方亮出的那張證物，現在也在你手上。
MSG_REBUILD.en: Last-Ditch Rebuild: the evidence they just played is now in your hands too.

MSG_REBUILD_FAIL.zh-TW: 還差一點……這樣論破不了。
MSG_REBUILD_FAIL.en: Almost there… but that won't Break them.

UI_RES_COST_OPP.en: The opponent walked away with the upper hand

WARN_RES_RETRY.zh-TW: 回到這場論戰開始時。線索板維持原樣。要重新論戰嗎？
WARN_RES_RETRY.en: Return to the start of this debate. The Clue Board stays as it was. Retry the debate?

WARN_RES_ACCEPT.zh-TW: 帶著這個結果進入下一案。確定嗎？
WARN_RES_ACCEPT.en: Carry this result into the next case. Are you sure?

ART_RES_CLEAN.zh-TW: 「乾淨俐落。我都不知道該在紀錄裡吐槽什麼了。」
ART_RES_CLEAN.en: "Clean and sharp. I don't even know what to grumble about in the record."

ART_RES_MID.zh-TW: 「贏是贏了。不過有幾段，我寫進紀錄的時候手有點抖。」
ART_RES_MID.en: "A win is a win. Though a few bits made my hand shake as I wrote them into the record."

ART_RES_NOTORIOUS.en: "Sherefox, tomorrow's paper... you might want to skip it."

ART_RES_LOSE.zh-TW: 「輸了一場而已。案子還沒結束，我們也還沒。」
ART_RES_LOSE.en: "We only lost a round. The case isn't over, and neither are we."

ART_RES_LOSE_NOTO.zh-TW: 「輸了，而且輸得很難看。回家吧，我煮點東西。」
ART_RES_LOSE_NOTO.en: "We lost, and not prettily. Let's go home; I'll cook something."

ART_ASSIST_DONE.zh-TW: 「接下來真的只能靠妳自己了。」
ART_ASSIST_DONE.en: "From here on, you're really on your own."

UI_PAPER_DISPUTE.en: The proceedings were reportedly rather contentious.

UI_PAPER_NOTO_LOSE.en: The detective's methods have also been called into question.

UI_SIDE_TRACE.zh-TW: Sherefox：「那時候我就該注意到的。」
UI_SIDE_TRACE.en: Sherefox: "I should have noticed it back then."

WARN_LOAD.zh-TW: 要讀取這個存檔嗎？未存檔的進度將會遺失。
WARN_LOAD.en: Load this save? Unsaved progress will be lost.

WARN_SAVE_DELETE.zh-TW: 要刪除這個存檔嗎？刪除後無法復原。
WARN_SAVE_DELETE.en: Delete this save? This can't be undone.

MSG_SAVE_FORBID_MASTER.zh-TW: 名偵探難度只能在日常中存檔。
MSG_SAVE_FORBID_MASTER.en: On Master Detective difficulty, you can only save during Daily scenes.

MSG_SAVE_FAIL.zh-TW: 存檔失敗。請確認儲存空間後再試一次。
MSG_SAVE_FAIL.en: Save failed. Please check your storage space and try again.

MSG_LOAD_FAIL.zh-TW: 這個存檔無法讀取，可能已經損毀。
MSG_LOAD_FAIL.en: This save can't be loaded. It may be corrupted.

MSG_LOAD_VERSION.zh-TW: 這個存檔來自不同的遊戲版本，將嘗試轉換。
MSG_LOAD_VERSION.en: This save is from a different game version and will be converted.

MSG_AUTOSAVE.zh-TW: 自動存檔中……請勿關閉遊戲。
MSG_AUTOSAVE.en: Autosaving… Do not close the game.

UI_RECALL_NOTE.zh-TW: 重看已通關章節的劇情。回想不會改變任何紀錄。
UI_RECALL_NOTE.en: Replay the story of chapters you've cleared. Recall doesn't change any records.

UI_FLOW_TRUE.zh-TW: True End 條件：關鍵推理 {a}／{b}　論戰勝利 {c}／{d}　黃金線索 {list}
UI_FLOW_TRUE.en: True End requirements: Key deductions {a}/{b} · Debates won {c}/{d} · Golden Clues {list}

UI_FLOW_TRUE_READY.zh-TW: 條件已全部達成。Ch.12 將以真相路線進行。
UI_FLOW_TRUE_READY.en: All requirements met. Chapter 12 will follow the True Route.

UI_FLOW_KEY_DETAIL.zh-TW: 關鍵證物「{name}」的歸類理由不正確。
UI_FLOW_KEY_DETAIL.en: The Rationale for Key Evidence "{name}" is incorrect.

WARN_FLOW_JUMP.zh-TW: 從「{chapter}・{step}」重新開始。目前的進度會先自動存檔。要開始嗎？
WARN_FLOW_JUMP.en: Restart from "{chapter} · {step}". Your current progress will be autosaved first. Begin?

WARN_FLOW_WRITE.zh-TW: 以下紀錄將會更新：{items}。較差的結果不會覆蓋原本的紀錄。要寫回嗎？
WARN_FLOW_WRITE.en: These records will be updated: {items}. Worse results won't overwrite your existing records. Write them back?

WARN_FLOW_LEAVE.zh-TW: 現在離開，這次重打不會寫回任何紀錄。要離開嗎？
WARN_FLOW_LEAVE.en: If you leave now, this replay won't write back any records. Leave?

UI_SET_DIFF_LOCKED.zh-TW: 只能在章節開始時更改難度。
UI_SET_DIFF_LOCKED.en: Difficulty can only be changed at the start of a chapter.

WARN_SET_DIFF_MASTER.zh-TW: 更改難度後，這個週目將不再符合「名偵探」成就的條件。要更改嗎？
WARN_SET_DIFF_MASTER.en: Changing the difficulty will make this playthrough ineligible for the "Master Detective" achievement. Change it anyway?

UI_SET_LINKSTYLE_DESC.zh-TW: 實證連結加粗，詭辯連結改為鋸齒線，方便辨識。
UI_SET_LINKSTYLE_DESC.en: Solid Links are drawn thicker and Sophistry Links become jagged, making them easier to tell apart.

UI_SET_DELEGATE_DESC.zh-TW: 只在故事模式可用。委託通過的論戰不計入 True End。
UI_SET_DELEGATE_DESC.en: Story Mode only. Debates won by delegation don't count toward the True End.

WARN_SET_DEFAULT.zh-TW: 要把這一頁的設定恢復成預設值嗎？
WARN_SET_DEFAULT.en: Restore this page's settings to their defaults?

WARN_SET_UNSAVED.zh-TW: 有尚未套用的變更。要套用嗎？
WARN_SET_UNSAVED.en: You have unapplied changes. Apply them?

WARN_KEY_CONFLICT.zh-TW: 這個按鍵已經指定給「{action}」。要交換嗎？
WARN_KEY_CONFLICT.en: This key is already assigned to "{action}". Swap them?

WARN_VIDEO_KEEP.zh-TW: 要保留這個畫面設定嗎？{n} 秒後將自動還原。
WARN_VIDEO_KEEP.en: Keep these display settings? They will revert automatically in {n} seconds.

UI_END_BAD.zh-TW: 敗北結局　還沒準備好的狐狸
UI_END_BAD.en: Bad Ending: The Fox Who Wasn't Ready

UI_END_NORMAL.zh-TW: 勝利結局　桌角的銀袖扣
UI_END_NORMAL.en: Victory Ending: The Silver Cufflink on the Table Corner

UI_END_TRUE.zh-TW: 真結局　附著咖啡豆的挑戰信
UI_END_TRUE.en: True Ending: The Challenge Letter with Coffee Beans

MSG_END_UNLOCK_FLOW.zh-TW: 「亞瑟的偵探筆記」已解鎖。可以從標題畫面或事務所選單開啟。
MSG_END_UNLOCK_FLOW.en: "Arthur's Casebook" is unlocked. Open it from the title screen or the Office menu.

MSG_END_HINT_TRUE.zh-TW: 似乎還有沒看清的真相。打開偵探筆記看看吧。
MSG_END_HINT_TRUE.en: There seems to be a truth you haven't seen clearly. Open the Casebook and take a look.

UI_ACH_CLEAN.zh-TW: 從不詭辯的偵探（一週目全程未被拆穿詭辯）
UI_ACH_CLEAN.en: The Sleuth Who Never Fibbed (no Sophistry exposed in the entire first playthrough)

MSG_ERR_PAD.zh-TW: 手把連線中斷。請重新連接。

MSG_ERR_DISK.zh-TW: 儲存空間不足，無法存檔。
MSG_ERR_DISK.en: Not enough storage space to save.

MSG_ERR_GENERIC.zh-TW: 發生錯誤，即將回到標題畫面。最近的自動存檔已保留。
MSG_ERR_GENERIC.en: An error occurred. Returning to the title screen. Your most recent autosave has been kept.

UI_STATE_HACHIKU_TIP.zh-TW: 勢如破竹：推理鏈傷害 +{dmg}%、反擊 +{ctr}%。滿 3 層時，論破少需 1 張證物。讀錯一手就會歸零。
UI_STATE_HACHIKU_TIP.en: Unstoppable: chain damage +{dmg}%, counter +{ctr}%. At 3 stacks, a Break needs 1 fewer piece of evidence. One misread move resets it to zero.

UI_STATE_KONJU_TIP.zh-TW: 困獸之鬥：對手的攻擊更重，也不能補強——但他的預兆會更清楚。
UI_STATE_KONJU_TIP.en: Cornered: the opponent hits harder and can't Reinforce, but their Tells become clearer.

UI_STATE_SHISSHU_TIP.zh-TW: 失守陣地：這一回合不能反駁，破竹歸零。
UI_STATE_SHISSHU_TIP.en: Position breached: you can't Rebut this round, and Unstoppable resets to zero.

UI_DEB_NOPARRY_SHISSHU.zh-TW: 失守：這一回合不能反駁

MSG_DEB_NOPARRY_SHISSHU.zh-TW: 陣腳還沒站穩——這一回合沒辦法截斷他。
MSG_DEB_NOPARRY_SHISSHU.en: Your footing isn't steady yet. You can't cut in on them this round.

MSG_STATE_HACHIKU_MAX.zh-TW: 勢如破竹，論破只差一步了！
MSG_STATE_HACHIKU_MAX.en: Unstoppable! One step from a Break!

MSG_STATE_KONJU.zh-TW: {name} 被逼成了困獸——小心反撲。
MSG_STATE_KONJU.en: {name} has been driven into a corner. Watch out for a counter.

ART_STATE_HACHIKU_MAX.en: "Now. He can't hold you back any longer."

ART_STATE_KONJU.zh-TW: 「他急了。急了的人，動作最好讀。」
ART_STATE_KONJU.en: "He's rattled. A rattled man is the easiest to read."

ART_STATE_SHISSHU.en: "Don't rush to cut in on him. Steady yourself first."

UI_SET_REDUCE_SHAKE_DESC.zh-TW: 大字與論破時的畫面震動改為輕微的縮放，手把震動也會減弱。
UI_SET_REDUCE_SHAKE_DESC.en: Screen shake during banners and Breaks becomes a gentle zoom, and controller rumble is weakened too.

SHF_C1_IDLE.zh-TW: 「有人動過我的東西，而且動得很小心。小心的人，最會留下小心的痕跡。」
SHF_C1_IDLE.en: "Someone's been at my things, and very carefully too. And careful people leave the most careful traces."

SHF_C1_REMAIN.zh-TW: 「等一下，還有東西沒看。我的耳朵在癢。」
SHF_C1_REMAIN.en: "Hold on, there's still something I haven't looked at. My ears are itching."

ART_OPEN_GEN.zh-TW: 「先別急著下結論。從門口開始，一樣一樣看。」
ART_OPEN_GEN.en: "Don't jump to conclusions. Start at the door and take things one at a time."

ART_OPEN_BODY.zh-TW: 「讓我先看看他。死人不會說謊，但也不會主動開口。」
ART_OPEN_BODY.en: "Let me take a look at him first. The dead don't lie, but they don't volunteer anything either."

ART_OPEN_FIELD.zh-TW: 「這裡沒有警督罩我們。進得去的地方，得自己想辦法。」
ART_OPEN_FIELD.en: "There's no Inspector to back us up here. We'll have to find our own way in."

ART_IDLE_1.zh-TW: 「妳盯著那面牆已經半分鐘了。牆不會招供的。」
ART_IDLE_1.en: "You've been staring at that wall for half a minute. Walls don't confess."

ART_IDLE_2.zh-TW: 「要不要換個角落看看？我看那邊比較可疑……雖然我也說不出為什麼。」
ART_IDLE_2.en: "Why not try another corner? That one looks more suspicious... though I couldn't tell you why."

ART_REMAIN_MANY.zh-TW: 「我總覺得這裡還有很多東西沒看到。」
ART_REMAIN_MANY.en: "I can't shake the feeling there's a lot here we haven't seen."

ART_REMAIN_FEW.zh-TW: 「差不多了吧。不過……好像還漏了一兩樣。」
ART_REMAIN_FEW.en: "That's probably enough. Although... I think we've missed a thing or two."

ART_REMAIN_NONE.zh-TW: 「該看的都看了。剩下的交給妳那顆腦袋。」
ART_REMAIN_NONE.en: "We've seen everything there is to see. The rest is up to that head of yours."

ART_TIME_LOW.zh-TW: 「時間不多了。警方……或別人，隨時會來收走現場。」
ART_TIME_LOW.en: "We're running short on time. The police... or someone else... could come and clear the scene any moment."

ART_TIME_LOW_FIELD.zh-TW: 「天快黑了。再晚，這裡的人就不會讓我們待著了。」
ART_TIME_LOW_FIELD.en: "It's getting dark. Any later and the locals won't let us stay."

ART_TIME_OUT.zh-TW: 「到此為止。走吧，Sherefox，再待下去就要被請出去了。」
ART_TIME_OUT.en: "That's it. Come on, Sherefox, any longer and we'll be shown the door."

ART_RESCUE.zh-TW: 「等等，妳腳邊那個——我替妳撿起來了。這個總不能不要吧？」
ART_RESCUE.en: "Wait, the thing by your feet. I picked it up for you. We can't leave without this, can we?"

ART_FOUND_KEY.zh-TW: 「這東西……看起來不該出現在這裡。」
ART_FOUND_KEY.en: "This... doesn't look like it should be here."

ART_FOUND_PLOT.zh-TW: 「這和案子有關嗎？……算了，先收著。」
ART_FOUND_PLOT.en: "Does this have anything to do with the case? ...Never mind, we'll hang on to it."

ART_APPR_MED.en: "Give me some room, and some light. ...Right, let me see."

ART_APPR_MED_DONE.zh-TW: 「這種傷口我在野戰醫護站見過。我能告訴妳它是什麼時候、怎麼造成的。」
ART_APPR_MED_DONE.en: "I've seen wounds like this at a field hospital. I can tell you when and how it happened."

ART_APPR_MECH.zh-TW: 「這個我熟。給我一分鐘，還有那支細的螺絲起子。」
ART_APPR_MECH.en: "This I know. Give me a minute, and that thin screwdriver."

ART_APPR_MECH_DONE.zh-TW: 「做工不差，但有人動過手腳。看這裡，刻痕是新的。」
ART_APPR_MECH_DONE.en: "Decent workmanship, but someone's tampered with it. Look here, the tool marks are fresh."

ART_APPR_DUAL.zh-TW: 「一半是血肉，一半是黃銅。兩種都得看——這可要花我不少工夫。」
ART_APPR_DUAL.en: "Half flesh, half brass. I have to look at both, and that's going to cost me some effort."

ART_APPR_INSIGHT.zh-TW: 「如果是這樣，妳剛才那個推論可能要重新想一下。」
ART_APPR_INSIGHT.en: "If that's the case, your earlier inference might need a second look."

ART_APPR_NONE.zh-TW: 「這個用不著我。肉眼就看得出來。」
ART_APPR_NONE.en: "You don't need me for this one. The naked eye will do."

ART_APPR_EMPTY.zh-TW: 「我的工具箱已經見底了。剩下的，只能靠妳的眼睛。」
ART_APPR_EMPTY.en: "My toolbox has run dry. The rest is down to your eyes."

ART_NO_REPORT.zh-TW: 「警督這次不肯給驗屍報告。看來得由我親自來了。」
ART_NO_REPORT.en: "The Inspector won't hand over the post-mortem report this time. It looks like I'll have to do it myself."

ART_NEGO_FAIL.zh-TW: 「……人家不吃這套。換個東西給他看吧。」
ART_NEGO_FAIL.en: "...He's not buying it. Show him something else."

ART_NEGO_LOCK.zh-TW: 「沒戲了。要進去，只能用不太體面的方法。」
ART_NEGO_LOCK.en: "No luck. The only way in now is something less than respectable."

ART_SNEAK.zh-TW: 「我什麼都沒看到。我只是個路過的修理工。」
ART_SNEAK.en: "I didn't see anything. I'm just a passing repairman."

ART_SUB_FOUND.zh-TW: 「這東西破成這樣，能派上用場嗎？……總比什麼都沒有好。」
ART_SUB_FOUND.en: "Something this battered, can it really be of use? ...Better than nothing, I suppose."

ART_CMP_HINT.zh-TW: 「我記得以前……是在那一帶吧？看看那邊。」
ART_CMP_HINT.en: "I seem to remember... it was somewhere around there? Have a look over there."

ART_CMP_HINT2.zh-TW: 「那個——對，就是那個。以前不是長這樣的。」
ART_CMP_HINT2.en: "That, yes, that one. It didn't used to look like that."

ART_CMP_REVEAL.zh-TW: 「Sherefox，看這裡。……這裡變了。我也是剛發現。」
ART_CMP_REVEAL.en: "Sherefox, look here. ...Something's changed. I've only just noticed it myself."

ART_SOPH_1.zh-TW: 「……妳是認真的嗎？這兩樣東西的關係，比我跟妳的作息還遠。」
ART_SOPH_1.en: "...Are you serious? Those two things are less related than your sleep schedule and mine."

ART_SOPH_2.zh-TW: 「說得通，勉強說得通。但只要有人戳一下，這裡就會斷。」
ART_SOPH_2.en: "It holds together, barely. But the moment someone pokes it, it'll snap right here."

ART_SOPH_3.zh-TW: 「我不反對。我只是想記下來，到時候出事了我有勸過妳。」
ART_SOPH_3.en: "I'm not objecting. I just want it on record that I did warn you, in case this blows up."

ART_SOPH_4.en: "That line... I'll pretend I didn't see it."

ART_SOLID.zh-TW: 「這兩樣接得上。嗯，這條線很結實。」
ART_SOLID.en: "Those two fit together. Yes, that line is sturdy."

ART_INVALID.zh-TW: 「這兩樣東西毫無關係。連詭辯都說不通。」
ART_INVALID.en: "Those two have nothing to do with each other. Not even Sophistry can make that work."

ART_SUB_LINK.en: "That scrap of paper won't hold for long, Sherefox."

ART_BOARD_READY.zh-TW: 「準備好了？妳的推理鏈，我都替妳記下來了。」
ART_BOARD_READY.en: "Ready? I've kept track of all your Reasoning Chains."

NEWS_02_LOSE_SUB.en: "The owner declined to be interviewed; the cuckoo in the shop window has stopped."

NEWS_03_WIN.en: Inspector Baskerville Solves Case at Lightning Speed: Barge Murder Culprit Arrested

NEWS_03_WIN_SUB.en: Inspector: "Scotland Yard never lets fog hide the truth."

NEWS_03_NOTO.zh-TW: 駁船命案破了　但狐耳偵探「靠胡攪蠻纏逼供」遭議
NEWS_03_NOTO.en: Barge Murder Solved, but Fox-Eared Detective Criticised for "Bullying a Confession Out of Him"

TUT_01_01_BODY.zh-TW: 現場的每個角落都可能藏著線索。移動游標，靠近時會發光的地方就是調查點，點一下就能調查。調查點有五種：檢視、證物、證詞、機關與鎖定區域。
TUT_01_01_BODY.en: Clues can hide in every corner of a scene. Move the cursor; anything that glows as you approach is an Investigation Point, and one click investigates it. There are five types: Examine, Evidence, Testimony, Mechanism, and Locked Area.

TUT_01_02_BODY.zh-TW: 調查得到的東西會變成證物卡，收進證物冊。卡上有五種屬性標籤：時間、地點、人物、物理特性、醜聞。之後推理時，系統就是靠這些標籤判斷證物之間接不接得上。
TUT_01_02_BODY.en: What you find becomes an Evidence Card and goes into your Evidence Book. Each card carries five kinds of Tag: Time, Place, Person, Physical, and Scandal. When you reason later, the game uses these Tags to decide whether two pieces of evidence fit together.

TUT_01_03_BODY.zh-TW: 與人交談也能取得線索。證詞卡和證物卡一樣可以拿來推理，而且一定帶有【人物】標籤。同一個人每案最多問兩次，要問什麼請想清楚。
TUT_01_03_BODY.en: Talking to people can turn up clues too. A Testimony Card can be used in reasoning just like an Evidence Card, and it always carries a 【Person】 Tag. You can question the same person at most twice per case, so think carefully about what to ask.

TUT_01_04_BODY.zh-TW: 左上的懷錶是蒐證的時間。從下一章起，每次調查新的地方都會花掉一格刻度，刻度用完就得離開現場。這一章是在自己家裡，時間不限，可以慢慢看。
TUT_01_04_BODY.en: The pocket watch at the upper left is your Evidence Search clock. From the next chapter on, every new place you investigate costs one Tick, and when the Ticks run out, you must leave the scene. This chapter takes place in your own home, so time is unlimited. Take your time.

TUT_01_05_BODY.zh-TW: 覺得看夠了，就按「結束蒐證」。結束後不能再回到現場，而你漏掉的線索，往往會落到對手手裡。
TUT_01_05_BODY.en: When you feel you've seen enough, press "End Search". Once you do, you can't go back to the scene, and the clues you missed often end up in your opponent's hands.

TUT_01_06_BODY.zh-TW: 這裡是整理推理的地方。從左邊的抽屜把證物卡拖到板上。板上最多可以放 15 張卡。
TUT_01_06_BODY.en: This is where you organise your reasoning. Drag Evidence Cards from the drawer on the left onto the board. The board holds up to 15 cards.

TUT_01_07_BODY.zh-TW: 每件證物都要寫下「它能證明什麼」。從右邊三個理由中選一個。三個都說得通，但只有一個與真相相符。沒選理由的卡不能連結。
TUT_01_07_BODY.en: For each piece of evidence, write down "what it proves". Choose one of the three Rationales on the right. All three sound plausible, but only one matches the truth. A card with no Rationale can't be linked.

TUT_01_08_BODY.zh-TW: 從卡片右緣的黃銅接口拖到另一張卡，就能把兩件證物連起來。共享相同標籤、而且理由都正確的兩張卡會接成一條實線，這叫「實證連結」。
TUT_01_08_BODY.en: Drag from the brass socket on a card's right edge to another card to link the two pieces of evidence. Two cards that share a Tag and both have correct Rationales are joined by a solid line. This is called a Solid Link.

TUT_01_09_BODY.zh-TW: 如果兩張卡共享標籤、但有一張的理由不對，或只靠一個表面上的「擦邊」標籤相接，線會變成虛線，這叫「詭辯連結」；沒有共同標籤的卡則連不起來，線會直接彈回。虛線的意義，之後的大案子會再說明。
TUT_01_09_BODY.en: If two cards share a Tag but one has the wrong Rationale, or they connect only through a tangential Tag, the line becomes dashed. This is called a Sophistry Link. Cards with no Tag in common can't be linked, and the line simply springs back. What dashed lines mean will be explained in a later, bigger case.

TUT_01_10_BODY.zh-TW: 用連結串成一直線的卡，就是一條推理鏈，2 到 5 張，不能分岔。板上最多 3 條。論戰時你出示的武器，就是這些推理鏈。
TUT_01_10_BODY.en: Cards strung together by links in a straight line form a Reasoning Chain: 2 to 5 cards, no branching. The board holds at most 3 chains. In a Debate, the weapons you present are these chains.

TUT_01_11_BODY.zh-TW: 論戰的每一回合，你和對手會同時決定要做什麼，再一起翻牌。你看不到他選了什麼，但他會露出「預兆」：一句話、一個小動作，和一個亮起的主張。這場不扣主導權，3 回合內指出亞瑟的 2 個矛盾就贏了。
TUT_01_11_BODY.en: Each round of a Debate, you and your opponent decide on your moves at the same time, then reveal together. You can't see what they chose, but they give off a "Tell": a line, a small gesture, and a lit claim. In this debate Dominance isn't deducted; you win by pointing out Arthur's 2 contradictions within 3 rounds.

TUT_01_12_BODY.zh-TW: 亞瑟挺起胸膛、雙手叉腰，說他一覺睡到天亮——他要「開口主張」了。右邊的眼睛圖示全睜開，代表這是「明示」：他一定會照這個預兆出手。
TUT_01_12_BODY.en: Arthur puffs out his chest and puts his hands on his hips, claiming he slept straight through until morning. He's about to Assert. The eye icon on the right is wide open, which means the Tell is "Clear": he will definitely make the move it shows.

TUT_01_13_BODY.zh-TW: 對手要開口時，選「反駁」：對準亮起的主張，備好能推翻它的證物，等他說到一半時截斷。選好證物後按「鎖定」。
TUT_01_13_BODY.en: When the opponent is about to speak up, choose "Rebut": aim at the lit claim, have evidence ready that can overturn it, and cut in halfway through his sentence. After choosing your evidence, press "Lock In".

TUT_01_14_BODY.zh-TW: 截斷成功時你不會受傷，被反駁的主張會被推翻。但反駁只能接住「開口」：對手如果在防守，反駁就會落空。
TUT_01_14_BODY.en: When a Cut-In lands, you take no damage and the targeted claim is overturned. But Rebut can only catch an Assert: if the opponent is defending, your Rebut whiffs.

TUT_01_15_BODY.zh-TW: 亞瑟把袖子往下拉，想遮住袖口——他要「補強」說法了。對手在防守時，就是出手的時候。選「實證連鎖」，出示一段只有實線的推理鏈。
TUT_01_15_BODY.en: Arthur tugs his sleeve down to hide his cuff: he's about to Reinforce his story. When the opponent is defending, that's your moment to strike. Choose "Solid Chain" and present a chain containing only solid lines.

TUT_01_16_BODY.zh-TW: 攻擊有兩種：實證連鎖與詭辯；防守也有兩種：反駁與觀察。哪一招對上哪一招會怎樣，都寫在右邊的「對決表」裡，論戰中隨時可以打開來看。
TUT_01_16_BODY.en: There are two kinds of attack, Solid Chain and Sophistry, and two kinds of defence, Rebut and Observe. What happens when one meets another is all written in the "Matchup Table" on the right, which you can open at any time during a Debate.

TUT_01_17_BODY.zh-TW: 亞瑟慌了，這是「動搖」。動搖的下一回合，用能直指真相的證物出手，就能「論破」他。他又要開口了：用反駁對準最後一個主張，出示袖口。
TUT_01_17_BODY.en: Arthur is flustered. This is "Shaken". On the round after he's Shaken, strike with evidence that points straight at the truth and you can "Break" him. He's about to speak again: Rebut, aimed at his last claim, presenting the cuff.

TUT_01_18_BODY.zh-TW: 亞瑟把你看到的小動作和對手的習慣都記在「對手筆記」裡。下次遇到同一個人，先翻一翻。
TUT_01_18_BODY.en: Arthur records the gestures you've seen and the opponent's habits in the "Opponent Notes". Next time you face the same person, give them a read first.

TUT_01_19_BODY.zh-TW: 亞瑟正式成為你的助手。從下一章起，他能鑑定醫療與機械類證物，並在論戰中替你擋下一次陷阱。
TUT_01_19_BODY.en: Arthur is now officially your assistant. From the next chapter on, he can appraise medical and mechanical evidence, and will block one trap for you during a Debate.

TUT_02_01_BODY.zh-TW: 從這一章開始，調查新的地方要花懷錶刻度。每個現場大約只看得完七成，哪裡值得花時間，由你決定。
TUT_02_01_BODY.en: From this chapter on, investigating a new spot costs pocket-watch Ticks. You'll only get through about seventy per cent of any scene, so it's up to you to decide where your time is best spent.

TUT_02_02_BODY.zh-TW: 卡上的「？」代表這個標籤還看不出來。選中卡片，按「交給亞瑟」，他會用醫療或機械知識替你鑑定。鑑定不花刻度，但每案次數有限。未鑑定的標籤不能用來連結。
TUT_02_02_BODY.en: A "?" on a card means that Tag can't be made out yet. Select the card and press "Hand to Arthur", and he'll appraise it with his medical or mechanical knowledge. Appraisals cost no Ticks, but the number per case is limited. Unappraised Tags can't be used for linking.

TUT_02_03_BODY.zh-TW: 你沒撿到的證物，有些會落到對手手中。它們會讓對手的說法更難推翻。畫面只會告訴你漏了幾件，不會說是哪幾件。
TUT_02_03_BODY.en: Some of the evidence you didn't pick up will fall into your opponent's hands, making their story harder to overturn. The screen will only tell you how many pieces you missed, not which ones.

TUT_02_04_BODY.zh-TW: 論戰比的是誰的推理更自洽。左下與右上的蒸汽壓力錶是雙方的「主導權」。把對手的主導權打到零，你就贏了；你的歸零，就輸了。
TUT_02_04_BODY.en: A Debate is a contest of whose reasoning is more self-consistent. The steam pressure gauges at the lower left and upper right are each side's "Dominance". Drive your opponent's to zero and you win; if yours hits zero, you lose.

TUT_02_05_BODY.zh-TW: 上方一排是對手的主張，亮起的那一個，就是他這回合要推的說法。他開口主張時，傷害是一個基礎值，再加上場上每個主張 4 點；推翻的主張越多，他說話就越沒分量。
TUT_02_05_BODY.en: The row of claims along the top belongs to your opponent, and the lit one is the claim he'll push this round. When he Asserts, the damage is a base value plus 4 for every claim on the table; the more claims you've overturned, the less weight his words carry.

TUT_02_06_BODY.zh-TW: 截斷成功：你不受傷，那個主張被推翻，對手還被你反咬一口，受到 30 點傷害。反駁一定要有能推翻亮起主張的證物；手上沒有的話，反駁按鈕會變灰，這時只能用觀察減傷。
TUT_02_06_BODY.en: On a successful Cut-In you take no damage, the claim is overturned, and you bite back for 30 damage. A Rebut needs evidence that can overturn the lit claim; if you have none, the Rebut button is greyed out, and all you can do is Observe to reduce the damage.

TUT_02_07_BODY.zh-TW: 對手這回合在防守，你的反駁沒有東西可接。他的補強成功了，主張回到場上，而且沒被打中的補強還會讓他回復一些主導權。
TUT_02_07_BODY.en: The opponent was defending this round, so your Rebut had nothing to catch. Their Reinforce succeeded, the claim returned to the table, and a Reinforce that isn't hit also restores some of their Dominance.

TUT_02_08_BODY.zh-TW: 只含實線的鏈段用「實證連鎖」出示。基礎傷害是 14，每多接一條實證連結，倍率就加 0.5。如果出示的證物正好推翻目標主張，主張會被粉碎。對手補強時，傷害會減半。
TUT_02_08_BODY.en: A chain segment containing only solid lines is presented as a "Solid Chain". Base damage is 14, and each additional Solid Link adds 0.5 to the multiplier. If the evidence you present happens to overturn the target claim, the claim is smashed. Against a Reinforce, damage is halved.

TUT_02_09_BODY.zh-TW: 你出手時對手也出手了：雙方各中一擊，而且在交鋒中，你的推理鏈只打得出一半的傷害。對手要開口的時候，反駁通常比搶攻划算。
TUT_02_09_BODY.en: You struck just as your opponent struck: both sides take a hit, and in a Clash your chain deals only half its damage. When the opponent is about to speak, Rebut is usually better value than rushing in.

TUT_02_10_BODY.zh-TW: 半睜的眼睛代表「模糊」：下面兩個行動，一個是真的，一個是誘餌。先看兩個選項是不是同一類——如果兩個都是攻擊，選防守就不會錯。
TUT_02_10_BODY.en: A half-open eye means "Vague": of the two moves listed below, one is real and one is a decoy. First check whether the two options are the same type. If both are attacks, defending is never wrong.

TUT_02_11_BODY.zh-TW: 有星號的那一個比較可能是真的：對手有些習慣，例如「說法被推翻後傾向補強」。這些習慣叫「行為規則」，亞瑟每看到一條就記進對手筆記。星號只是「比較可能」，不是保證。
TUT_02_11_BODY.en: The option with a star is more likely to be the real one: opponents have habits, such as "tends to Reinforce after a claim is overturned". These habits are called "Behaviour Rules", and Arthur records each one in the Opponent Notes as soon as he sees it. A star only means "likelier", not a guarantee.

TUT_02_12_BODY.zh-TW: 拿不定主意時，可以用「狐耳直覺」：模糊的預兆會拿掉誘餌，只剩真正的那一個。每場論戰只有兩次，用在關鍵的回合。
TUT_02_12_BODY.en: When you can't decide, use "Fox-Ear Instinct": a Vague Tell loses its decoy and leaves only the real move. You get just two per debate, so save them for the key rounds.

TUT_02_13_BODY.zh-TW: 被推翻的主張會消失，但對手每回合重新陳述時會補回一個說法。補進來的說法如果來自你漏掉的證物，角落會標出來。
TUT_02_13_BODY.en: An overturned claim disappears, but each round the opponent restates their case and adds a claim back. If the added claim comes from evidence you missed, it's marked in the corner.

TUT_02_14_BODY.zh-TW: 輸掉論戰不會結束遊戲，但下一個案子會從比較差的位置開始。只有最後一戰的結果，才會直接決定結局。
TUT_02_14_BODY.en: Losing a Debate doesn't end the game, but the next case starts from a worse position. Only the result of the final battle decides the ending directly.

TUT_02_15_BODY.zh-TW: 每個案子結束後，報紙會刊出「世人眼中的結果」——不一定是真相。你看過的報紙都會收進剪報簿。
TUT_02_15_BODY.en: After each case, the paper prints "the result as the world sees it", which isn't always the truth. Every issue you read goes into your Scrapbook.

TUT_02_16_BODY.zh-TW: 你讀對了他的出手。每次做出有利的應對——他開口時截斷、他補強時靜靜觀察、他布陷阱時用實證或觀察，或用醜聞證物讓他動搖——左下就疊一層「破竹」，最多三層。每一層讓推理鏈傷害和截斷的反擊各提高一成；疊滿三層時，論破還能少用一張證物。但只要應對錯一手，氣勢就會斷掉，從頭再來。實證撞補強仍能削減，但不算讀對；想疊破竹，對補強要用觀察（之後學會詭辯也可以）。
TUT_02_16_BODY.en: You read their move correctly. Every time you make a favourable response (cutting in when they Assert, quietly Observing when they Reinforce, answering a trap with solid evidence or Observe, or Shaking them with Scandal evidence), a layer of "Unstoppable" stacks up at the lower left, up to three. Each layer raises chain damage and Cut-In counters by ten per cent; at three layers, a Break needs one fewer piece of evidence. But one wrong response breaks your momentum, and you start over. A Solid Chain against a Reinforce still chips them down, but it doesn't count as a correct read; to stack Unstoppable against a Reinforce, use Observe (or Sophistry, once you've learned it).

TUT_03_01_BODY.zh-TW: 右上的警徽是巴斯克維爾警督對你的信任，共五枚。信任越高，他提供的驗屍報告、證人名單與現場權限越多；論戰輸了，或手段太難看，信任就會下降。
TUT_03_01_BODY.en: The badges at the upper right show how much Inspector Baskerville trusts you: five in all. The higher his trust, the more post-mortem reports, witness lists and scene access he provides; lose a debate, or use underhanded methods, and his trust drops.

TUT_03_02_BODY.zh-TW: 警督已經自信地抓了一個人。在正式調查之前，先糾正他的誤判：他開口時，用反駁出示一件能推翻他的證物。熱身不扣主導權；一次就說對，他會多給你一些情報；連錯三次，他就不耐煩了。
TUT_03_02_BODY.en: The Inspector has already confidently arrested someone. Before the real investigation, correct his misjudgement: when he speaks, use Rebut to present a piece of evidence that overturns him. Warm-ups don't cost Dominance; get it right in one go and he'll give you extra intelligence; get it wrong three times and he loses patience.

TUT_03_03_BODY.zh-TW: 黃色封條的區域需要許可。在警方參與的案子裡，警督的信任夠高就會讓你進去；信任不足時，就得想別的辦法。
TUT_03_03_BODY.en: Areas with yellow tape need a permit. In cases where the police are involved, the Inspector will let you in if his trust is high enough; if it isn't, you'll have to find another way.

TUT_03_04_BODY.zh-TW: 對手扯鬆領巾、往前踏了一步——這是「猛攻」。猛攻的傷害是一般主張的 1.25 倍。但這也是機會：在他猛攻時用反駁截斷，他會當場亂了陣腳。
TUT_03_04_BODY.en: The opponent loosens his cravat and steps forward: this is an "Onslaught". An Onslaught does 1.25 times the damage of an ordinary Assert. But it is also an opening: Cut In on an Onslaught with Rebut and they lose their footing on the spot.

TUT_03_05_BODY.zh-TW: 對手的壓力錶開始洩氣了，這是「動搖」：下一回合，對手受到的攻擊變成 1.5 倍，而且論破只能在那一回合打出。截斷猛攻、用醜聞類證物戳中痛處，或一次出示 4 張以上的實證連鎖，都能讓對手動搖。
TUT_03_05_BODY.en: The opponent's pressure gauge starts to leak: they are "Shaken". For the next round, the opponent takes 1.5 times damage from attacks, and a Break can only be played in that one round. Cutting in on an Onslaught, striking a sore spot with Scandal evidence, or presenting a Solid Chain of 4 or more cards can all leave an opponent Shaken.

TUT_03_06_BODY.zh-TW: 現在是論破的時機。出示一件指向唯一事實的強攻證物，或一段 2 張以上的實證連鎖，就能「論破」對手，直接削去他七成的主導權。用實證連鎖論破時，補強擋不住、陷阱也抓不到你；用反駁論破時，只有對手剛好開口才會成立。
TUT_03_06_BODY.en: Now is the time to Break. Present a Striker evidence that points to a single fact, or a Solid Chain of 2 or more cards, and you can "Break" the opponent, stripping away seventy per cent of their Dominance outright. When you Break with a Solid Chain, Reinforce can't stop it and traps can't catch you; when you Break with Rebut, it only works if the opponent happens to speak up.

TUT_03_07_BODY.zh-TW: 對手在防守，你的反駁論破落空了，動搖也跟著結束。下一次動搖時，如果看不出他要攻還是守，用實證連鎖比較穩。
TUT_03_07_BODY.en: The opponent was defending, so your Rebut-Break whiffed, and the Shaken state ended with it. Next time they're Shaken, if you can't tell whether they'll attack or defend, a Solid Chain is the safer bet.

TUT_03_08_BODY.zh-TW: 被論破的對手不會乖乖認輸，他會使出最後的反撲。反撲的類型一定是明示，但要出對的牌才擋得住。尾聲只有一回合：答錯了，你會受到 30 點傷害，論破也會失效。
TUT_03_08_BODY.en: A Broken opponent won't concede quietly; they will launch one last counterattack. The counterattack type is always Clear, but you must play the right card to stop it. The Endgame lasts only one round: answer wrongly and you take 30 damage, and the Break is voided.

TUT_03_09_BODY.zh-TW: 走投無路的犯人會開始胡亂栽贓。等他開口，用反駁截斷，出示一段 2 張以上、沒有弱點的實證連鎖，穩穩地結束它。不要觀察，也不要再用詭辯。
TUT_03_09_BODY.en: A cornered culprit starts flinging blame around wildly. Wait for him to speak, cut in with Rebut, and present a Solid Chain of 2 or more cards with no Weak Points to finish it for good. Don't Observe, and don't use Sophistry again.

TUT_03_10_BODY.zh-TW: 對手的主導權第一次掉到一半以下時，一定會猛攻，而且預兆是明示。記住這條規則：它是截斷猛攻、讓對手動搖的好機會。
TUT_03_10_BODY.en: The first time the opponent's Dominance drops to half or below, he will always go on the Onslaught, and the Tell will be Clear. Remember this rule: it's a perfect chance to cut in on his Onslaught and leave him Shaken.

TUT_03_11_BODY.zh-TW: 上一個案子裡，你正確推理出的關鍵證物，已經默默收進檔案，現在成了「黃金線索」。它指向唯一的事實，攻擊力最強。黃金線索不會因為使用而消失。
TUT_03_11_BODY.en: The key evidence you reasoned out correctly in the previous case has quietly been filed away, and is now a "Golden Clue". It points to a single fact and has the greatest attack power. A Golden Clue is not used up when you use it.

TUT_03_12_BODY.zh-TW: 你正面吃下了他的猛攻，陣地失守了。下一回合不能反駁，只能攻擊或觀察，破竹也歸零了。看到猛攻的預兆時，用反駁截斷它，才不會失守。詭辯被陷阱抓到、援護又沒擋下時，也會失守。
TUT_03_12_BODY.en: You took his Onslaught head-on, and your position is breached. Next round you can't Rebut, only attack or Observe, and Unstoppable resets to zero. When you see the Tell of an Onslaught, cut in on it with Rebut to avoid being breached. You are also breached when a Sophistry is caught in a trap and Cover doesn't block it.

TUT_03_13_BODY.zh-TW: 對手被逼成了困獸：被你截斷第二次，或主導權掉到三成以下時就會這樣。接下來兩回合，他的攻擊更重，也不能補強——但他急了，預兆會清楚一級。這是危險，也是機會。
TUT_03_13_BODY.en: The opponent has been driven into a corner: that happens when you cut in on them a second time, or when their Dominance falls below thirty per cent. For the next two rounds they hit harder and can't Reinforce, but in their desperation their Tell is one level clearer. This is both a danger and an opportunity.

TUT_04_01_BODY.zh-TW: 對手偵探維多・克勞已經封鎖了部分現場。蒐證時間比平常少；你漏掉的證物，他會撿走，而且會在論戰中拿來對付你。
TUT_04_01_BODY.en: The rival detective, Victor Crowe, has already sealed off part of the scene. You have less time to search than usual; any evidence you miss, he will pick up and use against you in the Debate.

TUT_04_02_BODY.zh-TW: 虛線是「詭辯連結」：兩張卡共享標籤，但其中一張的理由不正確，或只靠表面的「擦邊」標籤相接。詭辯的倍率是 0.8，比實證的 0.5 更高，但每條詭辯都會在鏈上留下一個弱點。
TUT_04_02_BODY.en: A dashed line is a "Sophistry Link": the two cards share a Tag, but one of them has an incorrect Rationale, or they connect only through a tangential Tag. Sophistry has a multiplier of 0.8, higher than Solid's 0.5, but every Sophistry Link leaves a Weak Point on the chain.

TUT_04_03_BODY.zh-TW: 含虛線的鏈段要用「詭辯」出示。對手補強時，詭辯能全額打穿他的防守，這是實證做不到的。你也可以在這時臨場硬接一條新的虛線，但它同樣會留下弱點。
TUT_04_03_BODY.en: A chain segment containing a dashed line must be presented as "Sophistry". When the opponent Reinforces, Sophistry punches through their defence at full damage, which a Solid Chain can't do. You can also improvise a new dashed link on the spot, but it too leaves a Weak Point.

TUT_04_04_BODY.zh-TW: 維多推了一下單片眼鏡——這是「設陷」。陷阱專抓詭辯：你這時出詭辯，傷害作廢，還會受到 25 點暴擊，那條虛線下一回合也會斷開。但陷阱對實證沒用：用實證連鎖出手，傷害全額打進去，他下一回合還不能補強。
TUT_04_04_BODY.en: Victor pushes up his monocle: this is "Set a Trap". Traps catch Sophistry: if you use Sophistry then, your damage is voided, you take a 25-point crit, and that dashed line snaps next round. But traps do nothing against solid evidence: attack with a Solid Chain and you deal full damage, and he can't Reinforce next round.

TUT_04_05_BODY.zh-TW: 覺得他要設陷、又非出詭辯不可時，可以先按「援護」再鎖定：這一回合若被陷阱抓到，亞瑟會替你擋下暴擊，虛線不會斷開，惡名也不會增加。但援護每場只有一次，鎖定就會用掉，就算他沒設陷也一樣——這是一次預測。
TUT_04_05_BODY.en: If you think he's about to Set a Trap but you have to use Sophistry anyway, press "Cover" before locking in: if the trap catches you this round, Arthur blocks the crit for you, the dashed line stays intact, and your Notoriety doesn't rise. But Cover can be used only once per debate, and it's spent the moment you lock in, even if he doesn't set a trap. It's a prediction.

TUT_04_06_BODY.zh-TW: 你沒出牌，靜靜看著他把陷阱擺好——現在大家都看見了。對手多了一個脆弱的主張，下一回合他一定會出攻擊。
TUT_04_06_BODY.en: You played no card and quietly watched him set the trap, and now everyone can see it. The opponent gains a Fragile claim, and next round they will definitely attack.

TUT_04_07_BODY.zh-TW: 被拆穿的詭辯不只會痛一次。報紙在看，警督也在看——手段太難看，明天的頭條不會好聽。
TUT_04_07_BODY.en: An exposed Sophistry hurts more than once. The papers are watching, and so is the Inspector; if your methods look ugly enough, tomorrow's headline won't be kind.

TUT_04_08_BODY.zh-TW: 角落寫著「來自：你漏掉的證物」的主張，是對手用你沒撿到的東西拼出來的。它和一般主張一樣打得碎，但它在提醒你：現場還有你沒看見的東西。
TUT_04_08_BODY.en: A claim marked "From: evidence you missed" in the corner was put together by the opponent from things you didn't pick up. It can be smashed like any other claim, but it's a reminder that there are things at the scene you haven't seen.

TUT_04_09_BODY.zh-TW: 維多會預判你重複上一回合的行動，先出它的剋招：你剛出過詭辯，他就設陷；你剛反駁，他就補強。對付這種對手，換招就是反制。
TUT_04_09_BODY.en: Victor predicts that you'll repeat your last round's action and plays its counter first: if you just used Sophistry, he Sets a Trap; if you just Rebutted, he Reinforces. Against this kind of opponent, changing your move is the counter.

TUT_04_10_BODY.zh-TW: 維多嘴上說「我認輸」，手卻把手套丟在桌上——那是他猛攻的動作。台詞與小動作對不上，就是「偽裝」：台詞會騙人，動作不會。以小動作為準。
TUT_04_10_BODY.en: Victor says "I concede" while tossing his glove on the table: that's the motion of his Onslaught. When the words and the gesture disagree, that's a "Disguise": words can lie, gestures can't. Go by the gesture.

TUT_04_11_BODY.zh-TW: 維多不會就此認輸，他會亮出手上的底牌——通常是你漏掉的那件證物。讀懂他的動作，在他出手時用反駁截斷，出示 2 張以上能推翻底牌的實證，就能收尾。後面的對手偵探，手段會更狠。
TUT_04_11_BODY.en: Victor won't concede so easily; he'll reveal the card up his sleeve, usually the very piece of evidence you missed. Read his gestures, cut in with Rebut when he strikes, and present 2 or more pieces of solid evidence that overturn his hole card to finish it. Later rival detectives will play dirtier.

TUT_04_12_BODY.zh-TW: 小心：對手偵探會反過來論破你。只要你出示的推理鏈裡有 3 條以上的詭辯，援護又已經用完，被他的陷阱抓到，就會被「逆・論破」。右下的狀態列會先亮紅警告你。
TUT_04_12_BODY.en: Beware: the rival detective can Break you right back. If the chain you present contains 3 or more Sophistry links, Cover has already been spent, and you are caught by his trap, you will be "Reverse Broken". The status bar at the lower right will flash red to warn you first.

TUT_05_01_BODY.zh-TW: 這次的對手不是犯人，而是想保護某個人的「庇護者」。他大多在補強自己的說法、轉移焦點，硬碰硬的證據很難直接打中他。
TUT_05_01_BODY.en: This opponent isn't a culprit but a "Protector" who wants to shield someone. He mostly Reinforces his story and shifts the focus, so hard evidence has trouble hitting him head-on.

TUT_05_02_BODY.zh-TW: 不確定該怎麼出手時，可以「觀察」：這回合不出牌，讓他繼續說下去。他開口時，你只受一半的傷，下一回合的預兆也會變成明示；他補強時，你會逼出一個說溜嘴的主張。
TUT_05_02_BODY.en: When you're unsure how to strike, you can "Observe": play no card this round and let him keep talking. If he speaks up, you take only half the damage and the next Tell becomes Clear; if he Reinforces, you force out a claim he let slip.

TUT_05_03_BODY.zh-TW: 說得越多，越容易說溜嘴。他補強時被你看出了破綻，多了一個「脆弱」的主張：任何攻擊打中它都能粉碎它，還會多造成 10 點傷害。
TUT_05_03_BODY.en: The more he says, the easier it is to let something slip. When he Reinforced, you spotted the flaw, so he gains a "Fragile" claim: any attack that hits it will smash it and deal 10 extra damage.

TUT_05_04_BODY.zh-TW: 他的補強沒有被打中，主導權回復了一成。對付愛補強的對手，與其一直防守，不如在他補強時用詭辯打穿，或先觀察，逼他說溜嘴。
TUT_05_04_BODY.en: His Reinforce wasn't hit, so his Dominance recovered by ten per cent. Against opponents who love to Reinforce, rather than just defending, punch through with Sophistry as they Reinforce, or Observe first to force a slip.

TUT_05_05_BODY.zh-TW: 帶口紅印標籤的是醜聞類證物。用實證連鎖出示它、戳中與人物有關的主張，對手就會動搖，不管他還剩多少主導權。
TUT_05_05_BODY.en: Evidence with a lipstick-mark Tag is Scandal evidence. Present it in a Solid Chain and hit a claim tied to a person, and the opponent becomes Shaken, no matter how much Dominance he has left.

TUT_05_06_BODY.zh-TW: 從這一章起，對手比較沉得住氣：4 張以上的實證連鎖，要等對手主導權降到六成以下，才能讓他動搖。醜聞類證物、黃金線索與截斷猛攻不受這個限制。
TUT_05_06_BODY.en: From this chapter on, opponents hold their nerve better: a Solid Chain of 4 or more cards can only leave them Shaken once their Dominance drops below sixty per cent. Scandal evidence, Golden Clues and cutting in on an Onslaught are exempt from this limit.

TUT_05_07_BODY.zh-TW: 中期以後的對手被論破後，會換一套說詞，例如從「我沒做」改成「我是為了保護某人」。尾聲時，要針對紫框的新說詞出手。中期以後，尾聲答錯會受到 60 點傷害。
TUT_05_07_BODY.en: From mid-game on, a Broken opponent switches to a second story, for example from "I didn't do it" to "I did it to protect someone". In the Endgame, aim at the new, purple-framed story. From mid-game on, a wrong answer in the Endgame costs you 60 damage.

TUT_05_08_BODY.zh-TW: 庇護者被揭穿後會打出悲情牌：「揭穿真相只會毀了一切，你承擔得起嗎？」這是一種補強，所以要出手攻擊，但一般物證說不動他。用實證連鎖出示帶有心形鎖的動機類證物，證明隱瞞才會帶來更大的災難。
TUT_05_08_BODY.en: Once exposed, the Protector plays the sympathy card: "Exposing the truth will only ruin everything. Can you bear that?" That is a kind of Reinforce, so strike back. But ordinary physical evidence won't move him. Present a Solid Chain with Motive evidence bearing a heart lock, to prove that hiding the truth will bring a greater disaster.

TUT_05_09_BODY.zh-TW: 這件東西不能拿上論戰，但它記住了一段關係。日後在某些對話裡，它會打開一個新的選項。劇情證物收在證物冊的「私人收藏」。
TUT_05_09_BODY.en: This item can't be taken into a Debate, but it remembers a relationship. In some conversations later, it will open up a new option. Story Evidence is kept in the Evidence Book under "Private Collection".

TUT_06_01_BODY.zh-TW: 這裡離倫敦很遠，沒有警督替你開門，也沒有驗屍報告。遺體與機械都要交給亞瑟鑑定；進不去的地方，要靠自己爭取。
TUT_06_01_BODY.en: It's a long way from London, with no Inspector to open doors and no post-mortem reports. Bodies and machinery must be handed to Arthur to appraise; where you can't get in, you'll have to talk your way in.

TUT_06_02_BODY.zh-TW: 看守的人不會因為你是偵探就放行。從證物冊選一件能說服他的證物出示。選對了就能進去；選錯了會白白花掉一格刻度。同一個人最多試三次。
TUT_06_02_BODY.en: Guards won't let you through just because you're a detective. Choose a piece of evidence from your Evidence Book that could persuade him, and present it. Choose right and you get in; choose wrong and a Tick is wasted. You can try the same person at most three times.

TUT_06_03_BODY.zh-TW: 紅色封條的區域只能潛入。潛入要花兩格刻度，而且有些地方再怎麼樣都潛不進去。
TUT_06_03_BODY.en: Areas with red tape can only be entered by sneaking. Sneaking costs two Ticks, and some places can't be sneaked into no matter what.

TUT_06_04_BODY.zh-TW: 外地章沒有警督可以糾正，也就沒有熱身小論戰。蒐證時爭取到的權限越多，論戰時手上的牌就越多。
TUT_06_04_BODY.en: In chapters away from London, there is no Inspector to correct, and so no Warm-up Debate. The more access you win during the Evidence Search, the more cards you'll hold in the Debate.

TUT_06_05_BODY.zh-TW: 從這裡起，論破的條件更嚴：對手動搖時，要出示 2 到 3 張沒有弱點的連鎖；或先用觀察逼出脆弱的主張，再用 2 張以上的實證打中它。論破會削去對手 75% 的主導權。
TUT_06_05_BODY.en: From here on, the conditions for a Break are stricter: when the opponent is Shaken, present a chain of 2 to 3 cards with no Weak Points; or first use Observe to force out a Fragile claim, then hit it with 2 or more pieces of solid evidence. A Break strips seventy-five per cent of the opponent's Dominance.

TUT_06_06_BODY.zh-TW: 從這裡起，對手大多只露出模糊的預兆。先看兩個候選是不是同一類；再看有沒有星號，想想上一回合發生了什麼：他剛丟了主張？你剛出了詭辯？他的習慣都在對手筆記裡。
TUT_06_06_BODY.en: From here on, opponents mostly give only Vague Tells. First check whether the two candidates are the same type; then look for a star, and think about what happened last round: did he just lose a claim? Did you just use Sophistry? His habits are all in the Opponent Notes.

TUT_06_07_BODY.zh-TW: 對手已經連續兩回合出同一招了。第三回合，他一定會換招——那一招可以從候選裡刪掉。
TUT_06_07_BODY.en: The opponent has made the same move two rounds in a row. On the third round, he will definitely change his move: you can strike that move off the candidate list.

TUT_06_08_BODY.zh-TW: 一攻一守又沒有線索時，找一招兩邊都不會大虧的：對手可能補強也可能主張，就用觀察：他開口，你只受一半傷、還看清下一手；他補強，你逼出一個脆弱的主張；可能設陷也可能主張，實證連鎖不怕陷阱。
TUT_06_08_BODY.en: When the two candidates are one attack and one defence with no star to go on, look for the move that doesn't lose badly against either. If he might Reinforce or Assert, Observe: if he speaks up, you take half damage and see his next move; if he Reinforces, you force out a Fragile claim. If he might Set a Trap or Assert, a Solid Chain doesn't fear traps.

TUT_07_01_BODY.zh-TW: 這場論戰分成兩段。第一段的對手是伯爵夫人（庇護者）；把她打完，第二段由維多・克勞接手，換成對手偵探的打法。你的主導權會延續到第二段，不會回復；亞瑟的援護每段各有一次，狐耳直覺則是整場共用。
TUT_07_01_BODY.en: This Debate comes in two parts. In the first, your opponent is the Countess (a Protector); once you've beaten her, Victor Crowe takes over, with a Rival Detective's style. Your Dominance carries over to the second part and is not restored; Arthur's Cover is available once per part, but Fox-Ear Instinct is shared across the whole debate.

TUT_07_02_BODY.zh-TW: 寫著「？」的主張，背後是你拿不到的家族證物。它還不能被選為目標。觀察能逼對手把它說出來；說出來之後，它就變成一般的主張。
TUT_07_02_BODY.en: A claim marked "?" is backed by family evidence you can't get hold of. It can't be targeted yet. Observe can force the opponent to say it out loud; once said, it becomes an ordinary claim.

TUT_07_03_BODY.zh-TW: 維多接手了。對手筆記換到他的那一頁：你在 Ch.4 學到的小動作都還在。他會偽裝預兆，看到沒有「依據」銅牌的明示時，先看他的手。
TUT_07_03_BODY.en: Victor has taken over. The Opponent Notes have turned to his page: the gestures you learned in Chapter 4 are all still there. He will Disguise his Tells; when you see a Clear Tell without the "Basis" brass tag, watch his hands first.

TUT_07_04_BODY.zh-TW: 維多承認剛才被你打碎的推理只是誘餌，接著亮出了真正的底牌。這一手會以偽裝的預兆出現：讀懂他的動作，在他出手時用反駁截斷，出示「鏈外事實」——也就是黃金線索——或專門推翻那張底牌的證物。打中了，就是「二連論破」，直接獲勝。
TUT_07_04_BODY.en: Victor admits the reasoning you just smashed was only bait, then reveals his real hole card. This move comes with a Disguised Tell: read his gestures, cut in with Rebut as he strikes, and present an "Outside Fact" (that is, a Golden Clue) or evidence made specifically to overturn that hole card. If it lands, it's a "Double Break", and you win outright.

TUT_07_05_BODY.zh-TW: 你的推理鏈全斷了，主導權只剩最後一點。但對手為了論破你，亮出了他藏得最深的證物——現在它也在你的線索板上了。你有一次重新拉線的機會：用它組出符合本章論破條件的鏈，就能「反擊論破」。
TUT_07_05_BODY.en: Your Reasoning Chains have all been severed and only the last sliver of Dominance remains. But in order to Break you, the opponent has played the most deeply hidden evidence he had, and now it's on your Clue Board too. You get one chance to redraw your links: assemble a chain that meets this chapter's Break conditions using it, and you can land a "Counter Break".

TUT_07_06_BODY.zh-TW: 你已經學會了所有論戰手法。接下來的對手，會把它們全部混在一起用。
TUT_07_06_BODY.en: You've now learned every debating technique. The opponents to come will use them all, mixed together.

TUT_08_01_BODY.zh-TW: 左邊是你記憶中的樣子，右邊是現在。找出五處變了的地方。點錯了不會怎樣，點錯幾次之後，亞瑟會開始提示你。
TUT_08_01_BODY.en: On the left is the city as you remember it; on the right, as it is now. Find the five things that have changed. A wrong click costs nothing, but after a few wrong clicks, Arthur will start giving you hints.

TUT_09_01_BODY.zh-TW: 卡框破損的證物，是用來替代你沒拿到的線索。它能幫你撐過這一戰，但用它拉的線一定是虛線，也不能當成鏈外事實。
TUT_09_01_BODY.en: Evidence with a broken card frame stands in for a clue you didn't get. It can help you survive this fight, but any link you draw with it is always a dashed line, and it can't count as an Outside Fact.

TUT_09_02_BODY.zh-TW: 這位對手會隨著主導權下降換三種打法：先是犯人，再是庇護者，最後是詭辯家。對手類型圖示會跟著換，對手筆記也會翻到對應的那一頁。只有最後一種打法時，才能論破他。
TUT_09_02_BODY.en: This opponent changes through three styles as their Dominance falls: first a Culprit, then a Protector, finally a Sophist. The opponent type icon changes with them, and the Opponent Notes turn to the matching page. You can only Break them in their final style.

TUT_10_01_BODY.zh-TW: 這是公開辯論，群眾也在聽。對手動搖時，沒有弱點的實證連鎖威力會變成三倍；含詭辯的鏈則照舊。但在群眾面前被陷阱抓到詭辯，會一口氣失去一半的主導權。
TUT_10_01_BODY.en: This is a public debate, and the crowd is listening. When the opponent is Shaken, a Solid Chain with no Weak Points deals triple damage; chains containing Sophistry stay as they are. But if a Sophistry is caught in a trap in front of the crowd, you lose half your Dominance at a stroke.

TUT_10_02_BODY.zh-TW: 最後的對手更沉得住氣：4 張以上的實證連鎖要等對手主導權降到一半以下才能讓他動搖。論破需要 3 到 4 張以上的連鎖，而且其中必須有黃金線索。後期的尾聲答錯，會受到 80 點傷害。
TUT_10_02_BODY.en: The final opponents hold their nerve better still: a Solid Chain of 4 or more cards can leave them Shaken only once their Dominance falls to half or below. A Break needs a chain of 3 to 4 or more cards, and it must include a Golden Clue. A wrong answer in the late-game Endgame costs you 80 damage.

TUT_10_03_BODY.zh-TW: 黑鐵框的主張是對手最核心的說法。實證連鎖照樣打得碎它；但要在他開口時截斷它，反駁就得用黃金線索——一般證物的反駁擋得住這一下、也能反擊，主張卻會留在場上。
TUT_10_03_BODY.en: A claim in a black-iron frame is the core of the opponent's story. A Solid Chain can still smash it; but to cut in on it as he speaks, your Rebut must use a Golden Clue. A Rebut with Common Evidence will block the hit and counter, but the claim stays on the table.

TUT_11_01_BODY.zh-TW: 宴會上，問話也要講究禮節。右上的扇子是你的禮儀：應對失禮會少一格，三格用完，貴族們就不會再跟你說話了。
TUT_11_01_BODY.en: At a banquet, even questions need manners. The fan at the upper right is your etiquette: each breach of manners costs one segment, and when all three are gone, the nobles will no longer speak to you.

TUT_11_02_BODY.zh-TW: 這場論戰分成幾個階段，中間不會回到線索板，對手的主導權也不會重置。援護與狐耳直覺都是整場共用，省著點用。
TUT_11_02_BODY.en: This Debate is split into several stages, with no return to the Clue Board in between, and the opponent's Dominance is not reset. Cover and Fox-Ear Instinct are shared across the whole debate, so use them sparingly.

TUT_12_01_BODY.zh-TW: Wolfhart 會故意示弱或示強，她的預兆有很多是偽裝。她的台詞不可信，但她的手不會說謊：敲指節是設陷、輕晃酒杯是補強、冷笑是主張；放下酒杯再冷笑，就是猛攻。
TUT_12_01_BODY.en: Wolfhart will deliberately show weakness or strength; many of her Tells are Disguised. Her words can't be trusted, but her hands don't lie: rapping her knuckles is Set a Trap, a gentle swirl of the wine glass is Reinforce, a cold smile is Assert; set the glass down and then smile coldly, and it's an Onslaught.

TUT_12_02_BODY.zh-TW: 你看穿了她。對她來說，台詞和動作對不上的那一刻，就是她露出的破綻。狐耳直覺也能直接看穿偽裝，但只有兩次。
TUT_12_02_BODY.en: You've seen through her. For her, the moment her words and gestures disagree is the moment she shows a weakness. Fox-Ear Instinct can also see through a disguise directly, but you only have two.

TUT_12_03_BODY.zh-TW: 一般的證物動搖不了她。只有兩種方法：用含黃金線索的反駁截斷她的猛攻；或在她剩一半以下時，用含黃金線索的 4 張以上實證連鎖打中她。
TUT_12_03_BODY.en: Ordinary evidence can't leave her Shaken. There are only two ways: cut in on her Onslaught with a Rebut that includes a Golden Clue; or, once she is at half Dominance or below, hit her with a Solid Chain of 4 or more cards that includes a Golden Clue.

TUT_12_04_BODY.zh-TW: 有些回合的結果早已寫好，不管你出什麼都改變不了。預兆區的眼睛會換成一枚鎖上的齒輪。撐過去，下一回合才是你的。
TUT_12_04_BODY.en: The outcome of some rounds has already been written, and nothing you play can change it. The eye in the Tell area is replaced by a locked gear. Survive it, and the next round is yours.

HEAD_CH01.zh-TW: 月桂糕點鋪限量『發條焦糖布丁』開賣首日，排隊人龍繞過貝克街兩圈
HEAD_CH01.en: Laurel Pastry Shop's Limited "Clockwork Caramel Pudding" Goes on Sale: Queue Winds Twice Around Baker Street

HEAD_CH01_SUB.zh-TW: 本報小廣告欄：「狐耳偵探事務所誠徵室友，會做飯者優先。」
HEAD_CH01_SUB.en: From the paper's classified column: "Fox-Eared Detective Agency seeks a flatmate. Those who can cook preferred."

HEAD_CH02.zh-TW: 百年古董懷錶遭掉包！富商怒告貝克街老鐘錶匠
HEAD_CH02.en: Century-Old Antique Pocket Watch Swapped! Wealthy Merchant Sues Baker Street's Veteran Clockmaker

HEAD_CH02_SUB.zh-TW: 格雷沙姆先生：「我的錶進店時完好如初。」
HEAD_CH02_SUB.en: Mr. Gresham: "My watch was in perfect condition when it went into the shop."

HEAD_CH03.zh-TW: 市政廳官員陳屍駁船鍋爐室！房門反鎖，警方已逮捕船夫
HEAD_CH03.en: Municipal Hall Official Found Dead in Barge Boiler Room! Door Bolted from Inside, Police Arrest Bargeman

HEAD_CH03_SUB.zh-TW: 巴斯克維爾警督：「兇手就在船上，本案今晚結束。」
HEAD_CH03_SUB.en: Inspector Baskerville: "The killer is on that barge. This case ends tonight."

E01_01_DESC.zh-TW: 盤子乾乾淨淨，只留下一圈完美的焦糖圓痕。沒有湯匙刮過的痕跡。
E01_01_DESC.en: The plate is spotless, with only a perfect ring of caramel left on it. There are no spoon scrape marks.

E01_01_REASON_A.zh-TW: 盤上沒有湯匙刮痕，布丁是整顆滑出去的，不是被吃掉的
E01_01_REASON_A.en: There are no spoon scrapes on the plate: the pudding slid off whole, it wasn't eaten.

E01_01_REASON_C.en: You finished it yourself and forgot

E01_02_NAME.en: The Handkerchief Bundle in the Fridge

E01_02_DESC.zh-TW: 冰箱角落有一小包手帕，打開來是一個冰冰涼涼的黃銅小輪子。
E01_02_DESC.en: In the corner of the fridge is a small handkerchief bundle. Opened, it holds a little brass wheel, ice-cold.

E01_02_REASON_A.zh-TW: 有人昨晚用冰箱冷卻一個精密的黃銅零件
E01_02_REASON_A.en: Someone used the fridge last night to chill a precision brass part.

E01_02_REASON_B.en: A part that fell off the fridge

E01_03_NAME.zh-TW: 亞瑟袖口的焦糖漬與黃銅細屑
E01_03_NAME.en: Caramel Stain and Brass Filings on Arthur's Cuff

E01_03_DESC.zh-TW: 袖口有一小塊琥珀色的焦糖漬，旁邊黏著幾粒金粉一樣的黃銅屑。
E01_03_DESC.en: There is an amber blob of caramel on the cuff, with a few grains of brass dust like gold powder stuck beside it.

E01_03_REASON_A.zh-TW: 他昨晚在冰箱旁，同時碰過布丁和懷錶零件
E01_03_REASON_A.en: Last night he stood by the fridge and touched both the pudding and the watch part.

E01_03_REASON_B.en: He took a bite of the pudding

E01_03_REASON_C.en: It got on there while he was cooking in the daytime

E01_04_NAME.zh-TW: 廚房地板上特別亮的一塊
E01_04_NAME.en: The Unusually Shiny Patch of Kitchen Floor

E01_04_DESC.zh-TW: 冰箱前的地板亮得可以照出人影，其他地方都灰撲撲的。
E01_04_DESC.en: The floor in front of the fridge shines bright enough to see your reflection; everywhere else is dull and dusty.

E01_04_REASON_A.zh-TW: 有人深夜把灑出來的東西擦掉了
E01_04_REASON_A.en: Someone wiped up a spill in the dead of night.

E01_04_REASON_B.en: The landlady mopped it this morning

E01_05_NAME.zh-TW: 亞瑟房門後的焦糖味抹布
E01_05_NAME.en: The Caramel-Scented Rag Behind Arthur's Door

E01_05_DESC.zh-TW: 門後掛鉤上掛著一條抹布，聞起來甜甜的。
E01_05_DESC.en: A rag hangs on the hook behind the door; it smells sweet.

E01_05_REASON_A.zh-TW: 擦地的人把抹布藏回了自己房間
E01_05_REASON_A.en: Whoever wiped the floor hid the rag back in their own room.

E01_06_NAME.zh-TW: 月桂糕點鋪的排隊號碼牌（05:30）

E01_06_DESC.zh-TW: 亞瑟外套口袋露出一角號碼牌，上面印著「05:30，第 1 號」。
E01_06_DESC.en: A corner of a queue ticket pokes out of Arthur's coat pocket, printed with "05:30, No. 1".

E01_06_REASON_A.zh-TW: 他天沒亮就出門，想買一顆新的布丁
E01_06_REASON_A.en: He left before dawn, hoping to buy a replacement pudding.

E01_07_NAME.en: The Blank Calling Card Under the Door

E01_07_DESC.zh-TW: 一張質地很好的空白名片，不知道什麼時候塞進來的。
E01_07_DESC.en: A blank calling card of very fine paper, slipped in at some point; nobody knows when.

E01_07_REASON_A.zh-TW: 深夜有人來過門口，卻刻意不留名
E01_07_REASON_A.en: Someone came to the door late at night and deliberately left no name.

E01_07_REASON_B.en: The paper boy slipped it under the wrong door

E02_01_DESC.zh-TW: 替換機芯裡的齒輪閃著冷硬的光，齒距細得不像話，不像古董，倒像兵工廠的產物。
E02_01_DESC.en: The gear inside the replacement movement gleams with a cold, hard light, its teeth too fine to be an antique, more like something out of an arsenal.

E02_01_REASON_A.zh-TW: 這是最新的軍工黑市規格，不是古董，也不是本店庫存
E02_01_REASON_A.en: It's the latest military black-market spec: not antique, and not this shop's stock.

E02_01_REASON_B.en: A rare part the owner kept privately

E02_01_REASON_C.en: The wealthy merchant swapped it himself long ago

E02_02_DESC.zh-TW: 店裡最醒目的報時鳥鐘，木頭小鳥正歪著頭，像是在等下一次登場。
E02_02_DESC.en: The most eye-catching cuckoo clock in the shop; the little wooden bird has its head cocked, as though waiting for its next appearance.

E02_02_REASON_A.zh-TW: 鐘被人為調慢了整整 3 分鐘
E02_02_REASON_A.en: The clock was deliberately set exactly 3 minutes slow.

E02_02_REASON_B.en: The spring wore out and it slowed naturally

E02_02_REASON_C.en: The owner set it slow on purpose

E02_03_NAME.en: Fresh Scratches on the Pendulum Cover

E02_03_DESC.zh-TW: 護蓋邊緣有一道細細的新刮痕，金屬底色還很亮。
E02_03_DESC.en: A thin, fresh scratch runs along the edge of the cover; the metal beneath is still bright.

E02_03_REASON_A.zh-TW: 今天有人用小起子撬開護蓋
E02_03_REASON_A.en: Someone pried the cover open with a small screwdriver today.

E02_03_REASON_B.en: Left by the owner's weekly maintenance

E02_04_DESC.zh-TW: 「大笨鐘敲三點的時候，我從窗戶看到老爺爺進去後面了，櫃台只剩那個穿黑衣服的大哥哥。」
E02_04_DESC.en: "When Big Ben struck three, I saw the old gentleman go into the back through the window, and only that big brother in the black clothes was left at the counter."

E02_04_REASON_A.zh-TW: 大笨鐘敲三點時，櫃台只剩費奇一人
E02_04_REASON_A.en: When Big Ben struck three, only Fitch was left at the counter.

E02_04_REASON_C.en: What he saw was the wealthy merchant

E02_05_NAME.zh-TW: 寄修收據（店鐘 3:05 簽收）
E02_05_NAME.en: Repair Receipt (Signed for at 3:05 Shop Time)

E02_05_DESC.zh-TW: 霍洛威老先生的簽收字跡工整，時間寫著「三點零五分」，依據的是店裡的鐘。
E02_05_DESC.en: Old Mr. Holloway signed for it in neat handwriting, the time written as "3:05", going by the shop's clock.

E02_05_REASON_A.zh-TW: 收據時間依店鐘記錄，實際是 3:08
E02_05_REASON_A.en: The receipt time was taken from the shop clock; the real time was 3:08.

E02_05_REASON_C.en: The swap had already happened by the time it was signed for

E02_06_DESC.zh-TW: 四十年來每一顆進貨零件都記在這本冊子裡，字跡從年輕寫到年老。
E02_06_DESC.en: Every part bought in over forty years is recorded in this ledger, the handwriting running from young to old.

E02_06_REASON_A.zh-TW: 本店從未進過雙層發條
E02_06_REASON_A.en: This shop has never stocked a double mainspring.

E02_06_REASON_B.en: The catalogue wasn't kept up to date

E02_06_REASON_C.en: The owner bought parts privately and left them off the books

E02_07_DESC.zh-TW: 費奇鞠躬時，袖口落下一點金色的粉末。
E02_07_DESC.en: When Fitch bowed, a little golden powder fell from his cuff.

E02_07_REASON_A.zh-TW: 與替換機芯是同一批黃銅
E02_07_REASON_A.en: Same batch of brass as the replacement movement.

E02_07_REASON_B.zh-TW: 他幫主人擦馬車留下的
E02_07_REASON_B.en: He picked them up polishing his master's carriage

E02_08_DESC.zh-TW: （論戰後取得）角落那位女士留下的瓷杯，杯身有一道從邊緣裂到杯底的痕。
E02_08_DESC.en: (Obtained after the debate) A porcelain cup left behind by the lady in the corner, with a crack running from the rim to the base.

E02_08_REASON_A.zh-TW: 有人刻意擋下了擲向 Sherefox 的配重
E02_08_REASON_A.en: Someone deliberately blocked the counterweight thrown at Sherefox.

E02_08_REASON_C.en: It cracked from the hot coffee

E03_01_DESC.zh-TW: 死者的皮膚有大片蒸汽燙傷，喉頭水腫，指甲裡卡著門板的木屑。
E03_01_DESC.en: The victim's skin bears extensive steam scalds, the throat is swollen, and splinters of door wood are lodged under the fingernails.

E03_01_REASON_A.zh-TW: 死於 22:00～22:30 的蒸汽窒息，不是鈍器
E03_01_REASON_A.en: Died of steam asphyxiation between 22:00 and 22:30, not of a blunt blow.

E03_02_NAME.en: The Bolt Dropped from the Inside

E03_02_DESC.zh-TW: 沉重的黃銅門閂，一端連著一根細蒸汽管，管口還有水垢。
E03_02_DESC.en: A heavy brass bolt, one end connected to a thin steam pipe, with limescale still on the pipe mouth.

E03_02_REASON_A.zh-TW: 門閂由蒸汽壓力推動，可從甲板遠端操作
E03_02_REASON_A.en: The bolt is driven by steam pressure and can be operated at a distance from the deck.

E03_02_REASON_B.en: The deceased locked the door himself

E03_02_REASON_C.en: The old bolt slid down on its own

E03_03_NAME.zh-TW: 甲板上被轉過的壓力閥
E03_03_NAME.en: The Pressure Valve Turned on the Deck

E03_03_DESC.zh-TW: 閥柄上有一枚煤灰指印，指紋又寬又長，比老湯姆粗短的手指大了一圈。
E03_03_DESC.en: On the valve handle is a soot fingerprint, wide and long, a size larger than Old Tom's short, stubby fingers.

E03_03_REASON_A.zh-TW: 閥柄上的煤灰指印是新的，不是船夫的大小
E03_03_REASON_A.en: The soot fingerprint on the handle is fresh, and it isn't the bargeman's size.

E03_03_REASON_C.en: The waves rocking the barge turned it

E03_04_NAME.zh-TW: 卡死洩壓閥的黃銅零件
E03_04_NAME.en: The Brass Part Jamming the Relief Valve

E03_04_DESC.zh-TW: 洩壓閥的出口塞著一顆不該在那裡的黃銅零件，表面刻著一串細小的批號。
E03_04_DESC.en: Jammed in the relief valve's outlet is a brass part that shouldn't be there, a string of tiny batch numbers engraved on its surface.

E03_04_REASON_A.zh-TW: 批號與軍工黑市抄本相符，是死者私吞的同批貨
E03_04_REASON_A.en: Its batch number matches the military black-market transcript: it's from the same stolen batch the deceased had skimmed.

E03_04_REASON_C.en: The bargeman stuffed it in carelessly

E03_05_DESC.zh-TW: 一把磨得發亮的舊鑰匙，四十年來只開過這艘船的艙門。
E03_05_DESC.en: A worn, polished old key that has opened only this barge's hatch for forty years.

E03_05_REASON_A.zh-TW: 只能開艙門外鎖，碰不到壓力閂
E03_05_REASON_A.en: It opens only the hatch's outer lock and can't touch the pressure latch.

E03_05_REASON_B.en: It proves only he could get in

E03_06_NAME.zh-TW: 皮爾斯大衣下擺的煤灰
E03_06_NAME.en: Coal Soot on the Hem of Pierce's Coat

E03_06_DESC.zh-TW: 皮爾斯先生的大衣剪裁講究，下擺卻沾了一圈煤灰。
E03_06_DESC.en: Mr. Pierce's coat is finely tailored, yet the hem is ringed with coal soot.

E03_06_REASON_A.zh-TW: 與甲板閥門上的煤灰相同
E03_06_REASON_A.en: It's the same soot as on the deck valve.

E03_06_REASON_B.en: He'd been to the coal depot

E03_06_REASON_C.en: Everyone in London has coal soot on them

E03_07_NAME.en: The Purchase Order Found on the Deceased

E03_07_DESC.zh-TW: 市政採購單上寫著「黃銅零件三百件」，入庫章上卻只蓋了兩百件。
E03_07_DESC.en: The municipal purchase order says "brass parts, 300 units", but the goods-received stamp covers only 200.

E03_07_REASON_A.zh-TW: 採購數與入庫數不符，兩人合夥私吞
E03_07_REASON_A.en: The ordered and received quantities don't match: the two partners skimmed it together.

E03_08_DESC.zh-TW: 最後一頁寫著「22:10，R. P. 登船，清點貨物」，字跡潦草，但看得出是誰的。
E03_08_DESC.en: The last page reads "22:10, R. P. boards, counts cargo", in hasty handwriting, but you can tell whose it is.

E03_08_REASON_A.zh-TW: 22:10 有人登船，筆跡是皮爾斯的
E03_08_REASON_A.en: Someone boarded at 22:10, and the handwriting is Pierce's.

E03_08_REASON_B.en: The log was written up later by the bargeman

E03_09_DESC.zh-TW: 死者桌上的通知書，下週開始年度採購審計，提議人欄只簽了一個字母：W.。
E03_09_DESC.en: The notice on the victim's desk says the annual procurement audit begins next week; the proposer's column is signed with a single letter: W.

E03_09_REASON_A.zh-TW: 審計由市政顧問「W.」提議，促使死者想自首
E03_09_REASON_A.en: The audit was proposed by municipal advisor "W.", which pushed the deceased toward confessing.

CLM_CH01_N1.en: I slept straight through until morning

CLM_CH01_N3.zh-TW: 布丁的事跟我一點關係都沒有
CLM_CH01_N3.en: I have nothing whatsoever to do with the pudding

CLM_CH02_N1.zh-TW: 我在報時鳥報三點時就離開了
CLM_CH02_N1.en: I left the moment the cuckoo struck three

CLM_CH02_N2.zh-TW: 老闆有工具也有時間掉包
CLM_CH02_N2.en: The owner had both the tools and the time to swap it

CLM_CH02_N3.zh-TW: 新機芯是這家店的零件
CLM_CH02_N3.en: The new movement is one of this shop's parts

CLM_CH03_N2.en: The door locked from the inside; it was an accident

SCR_CH01_S01_L002.zh-TW: 【倫敦提燈報・1887 年 10 月】月桂糕點鋪限量「發條焦糖布丁」開賣首日，排隊人龍繞過貝克街兩圈
SCR_CH01_S01_L002.en: 【The London Lantern · October 1887】Laurel Pastry Shop's Limited "Clockwork Caramel Pudding" Goes on Sale: Queue Winds Twice Around Baker Street

SCR_CH01_S01_L003.zh-TW: 本報訊，貝克街月桂糕點鋪昨日推出新品「發條焦糖布丁」，以黃銅發條造型的焦糖頂飾聞名，每日限量四十顆，開店一小時即售罄。排隊人群中不乏專程前來的紳士淑女，其中一位狐耳少女據稱「尾巴從頭到尾都沒有停過」。另，本報小廣告欄刊有啟事一則：「狐耳偵探事務所誠徵室友，會做飯者優先，不接受怕狐狸毛的人。」
SCR_CH01_S01_L003.en: Our correspondent reports: Laurel Pastry Shop on Baker Street yesterday launched its new "Clockwork Caramel Pudding", famed for its caramel topping shaped like a brass clockwork spring. Limited to forty a day, they sold out within an hour of opening. Among the queue were many ladies and gentlemen who had come specially, including one fox-eared girl whose tail was reportedly "never still from start to finish". Also, this paper's classified column carries a notice: "Fox-Eared Detective Agency seeks a flatmate. Cooks preferred; those afraid of fox fur need not apply."

SCR_CH01_S02_L001.zh-TW: 場景 2：事務所客廳（日常・前一晚）
SCR_CH01_S02_L001.en: Scene 2: Agency Living Room (Daily Life; The Night Before)

SCR_CH01_S02_L002.zh-TW: 我搬進貝克街的第二天，學到了三件事。第一，房東太太的燉菜很鹹。第二，我的室友是狐狸。第三，狐狸把布丁當成國寶。
SCR_CH01_S02_L002.en: On my second day in Baker Street, I learned three things. First, the landlady's stew is far too salty. Second, my flatmate is a fox. Third, foxes treat pudding as a national treasure.

SCR_CH01_S02_L003.zh-TW: （雙手捧著盤子，尾巴晃個不停）亞瑟，看清楚。這是月桂糕點鋪的發條焦糖布丁，每天只有四十顆，我排了一個小時。
SCR_CH01_S02_L003.en: (Cradling the plate in both hands, tail swishing nonstop) Arthur, look closely. This is the Laurel Pastry Shop's Clockwork Caramel Pudding. Only forty a day, and I queued for an hour.

SCR_CH01_S02_L005.zh-TW: 它不只有彈性，它有尊嚴。（在盤上插一面小旗）「狐狸專用，偷吃者咬。」明天早上我要配紅茶吃。
SCR_CH01_S02_L005.en: It's not just bouncy, it has dignity. (Plants a little flag in the plate) "Foxes only. Thieves will be bitten." I'm having it with tea tomorrow morning.

SCR_CH01_S02_L006.zh-TW: 我明白了。我不會碰它的。

SCR_CH01_S02_L007.zh-TW: （拉開抽屜看了一眼摔壞的懷錶，又輕輕關上）……
SCR_CH01_S02_L007.en: (Opens the drawer, glances at the broken pocket watch, then quietly closes it again) ...

SCR_CH01_S02_L008.en: What happened to that pocket watch?

SCR_CH01_S02_L009.zh-TW: 沒事沒事，老東西了。我去睡了，晚安。
SCR_CH01_S02_L009.en: Nothing, nothing, just an old thing. I'm off to bed. Good night.

SCR_CH01_S02_L010.zh-TW: 她說「沒事」的時候，耳朵是往下垂的。我在戰地當過醫護兵，知道人在說謊時身體會先招供。那一晚我決定做一件事。後來證明，那是一連串小災難的開始。
SCR_CH01_S02_L010.en: When she said "nothing", her ears drooped. I served as a medic on the battlefield, and I know that when people lie, the body confesses first. That night I decided to do something. It would prove to be the start of a string of small disasters.

SCR_CH01_S03_L001.zh-TW: 場景 3：事務所廚房（事件・早晨）

SCR_CH01_S03_L002.zh-TW: （打開冰箱，耳朵瞬間豎直）……亞瑟。
SCR_CH01_S03_L002.en: (Opens the fridge; her ears snap upright) ...Arthur.

SCR_CH01_S03_L003.zh-TW: （從房裡探頭，頭髮亂翹）早、早安。
SCR_CH01_S03_L003.en: (Poking his head out of his room, hair sticking up) M-morning.

SCR_CH01_S03_L004.zh-TW: 我的布丁不見了。盤子還在，小旗還在，布丁不在。這是綁架。這是一樁綁架案。
SCR_CH01_S03_L004.en: My pudding is gone. The plate is here, the flag is here, the pudding is not. This is a kidnapping. This is a case of puddingnapping.

SCR_CH01_S03_L007.zh-TW: 野貓。倫敦的野貓很靈巧的。
SCR_CH01_S03_L007.en: A stray. London strays are very nimble.

SCR_CH01_S03_L008.zh-TW: （瞇眼，尾巴緩緩擺動）亞瑟，你昨晚出過房門嗎？
SCR_CH01_S03_L008.en: (Narrowing her eyes, tail swaying slowly) Arthur, did you leave your room last night?

SCR_CH01_S03_L009.en: N-no. I slept straight through until morning.

SCR_CH01_S03_L010.zh-TW: 很好。那麼這樁布丁綁架案的第一號嫌疑人，就是全事務所除了我以外唯一的人。
SCR_CH01_S03_L010.en: Splendid. Then Suspect Number One in this puddingnapping is the only other person in the whole agency besides me.

SCR_CH01_S03_L012.zh-TW: 不，是在「審問」你。審完我會道歉。如果你是無辜的話。
SCR_CH01_S03_L012.en: No, I'm "interrogating" you. I'll apologise afterwards, if you turn out to be innocent.

SCR_CH01_S04_L002.zh-TW: 盤子乾乾淨淨，只留下一圈完美的焦糖圓痕。沒有湯匙刮過的痕跡。
SCR_CH01_S04_L002.en: The plate is spotless, with only a perfect ring of caramel left on it. There are no spoon scrape marks.

SCR_CH01_S04_L003.en: A-a cat would lick it very clean, wouldn't it?

SCR_CH01_S04_L004.zh-TW: 貓舔得出這麼圓的圈？那牠應該去當鐘錶匠。
SCR_CH01_S04_L004.en: Can a cat lick a ring that perfectly round? Then that cat belongs in a clockmaker's shop.

SCR_CH01_S04_L005.zh-TW: 冰箱角落有一小包手帕，打開來是一個冰冰涼涼的黃銅小輪子。
SCR_CH01_S04_L005.en: In the corner of the fridge is a small handkerchief bundle. Opened, it holds a little brass wheel, ice-cold.

SCR_CH01_S04_L006.en: Th-that's... a fridge part, I suppose.

SCR_CH01_S04_L007.zh-TW: 袖口有一小塊琥珀色的焦糖漬，旁邊黏著幾粒金粉一樣的黃銅屑。
SCR_CH01_S04_L007.en: There is an amber blob of caramel on the cuff, with a few grains of brass dust like gold powder stuck beside it.

SCR_CH01_S04_L008.zh-TW: （把袖子往下拉）這是……昨天晚餐的醬汁。
SCR_CH01_S04_L008.en: (Pulling his sleeve down) This is... sauce from last night's dinner.

SCR_CH01_S04_L009.zh-TW: 昨天晚餐是房東太太的燉菜。燉菜不會是甜的。
SCR_CH01_S04_L009.en: Last night's dinner was the landlady's stew. Stew is never sweet.

SCR_CH01_S04_L010.zh-TW: 冰箱前的地板亮得可以照出人影，其他地方都灰撲撲的。
SCR_CH01_S04_L010.en: The floor in front of the fridge shines bright enough to see your reflection; everywhere else is dull and dusty.

SCR_CH01_S04_L011.en: The landlady is very fond of cleanliness.

SCR_CH01_S04_L012.zh-TW: 房東太太只擦她自己看得到的地方。
SCR_CH01_S04_L012.en: The landlady only wipes the places she can see herself.

SCR_CH01_S04_L013.zh-TW: 門後掛鉤上掛著一條抹布，聞起來甜甜的。
SCR_CH01_S04_L013.en: A rag hangs on the hook behind the door; it smells sweet.

SCR_CH01_S04_L015.zh-TW: 亞瑟外套口袋露出一角號碼牌，上面印著「05:30，第 1 號」。
SCR_CH01_S04_L015.en: A corner of a queue ticket pokes out of Arthur's coat pocket, printed with "05:30, No. 1".

SCR_CH01_S04_L017.zh-TW: 第 1 號？你撿到了全倫敦最早起床的那個人？
SCR_CH01_S04_L017.en: Number 1? You just happened to pick up the earliest riser in all London?

SCR_CH01_S04_L018.zh-TW: 一張質地很好的空白名片，不知道什麼時候塞進來的。
SCR_CH01_S04_L018.en: A blank calling card of very fine paper, slipped in at some point; nobody knows when.

SCR_CH01_S04_L019.zh-TW: 那個我真的不知道。（這次好像是真的）
SCR_CH01_S04_L019.en: That one I really don't know about. (This time it seems to be true.)

SCR_CH01_S04_L020.zh-TW: Sherefox 把它收進抽屜，說好的紙不該浪費。
SCR_CH01_S04_L020.en: Sherefox put it away in a drawer, saying good paper shouldn't be wasted.

SCR_CH01_S90_L002.zh-TW: 亞瑟在本章只用「主張」與「補強」，預兆全部明示。本章亞瑟是對手，提示由系統教學台詞代替。
